text:
Batil aqaid ki tardeed. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke yeh Quran-e-Azeem usi ka kalam hai aur usi ka utara hua hai. Is ke haq hone mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin. Jaise aur jagah hai (Wa innahu latanzilu Rabbil 'Alamin) (Surah Ash-Shu'ara: 192), yeh Rabbul Alameen ki taraf se nazil kiya hua hai. Jise Rooh-ul-Amin le kar utra hai. Tere dil par utra hai taake tu aagah karne wala ban jaye. Saaf faseeh Arabi zaban mein hai aur aayaton mein hai yeh ba-izzat kitab woh hai jis ke aage ya peeche se batil aa hi nahin sakta, yeh hikmaton wali tareefon wale Allah ki taraf se utri hai. Yahan farmaya ke yeh kitab bahut bade izzat wale aur hikmat wale Allah ki taraf se utri hai jo apne aqwal, af'aal, shariat, taqdeer sab mein hikmaton wala hai. Hum ne teri taraf is kitab ko haq ke sath nazil farmaya hai. Tujhe chahiye ke khud Allah ki ibadaton mein aur us ki tauheed mein mashghool reh kar sari duniya ko usi taraf bula, kyunke us Allah ke siwa kisi ki ibadat zeba nahin, woh la-shareek hai, woh be-misal hai, us ka shareek koi nahin. Deen-e-khalis yani shahadat-e-tauheed ke laiq wahi hai. Phir mushrikon ka napak aqeeda bayan kiya ke woh farishton ko Allah ka muqarrab jaan kar un ki khayali tasveerein bana kar un ki pooja paat karne lage yeh samajh kar ke yeh Allah ke laadle hain, hamein jaldi Allah ka muqarrab bana denge. Phir to hamari roziyon mein aur har cheez mein khoob barkat ho jaye gi. Yeh matlab nahin ke Qayamat ke roz hamein woh nazdeki aur martaba dilwayenge. Is liye ke Qayamat ke to woh qail hi na thay. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke woh unhein apna sifarishi jante thay. Jahiliyat ke zamane mein Hajj ko jate to wahan labbaik pukarte hue kehte Allah hum tere paas hazir hue. Tera koi shareek nahin magar aise shareek jin ke apne aap ka malik bhi tu hi hai aur jo cheezein un ke matahat hain un ka bhi haqeeqi malik tu hi hai. Yehi shuba agle pichle tamam mushrikon ko raha aur isi ko tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) rad karte rahe aur sirf Allah Ta'ala wahid ki ibadat ki taraf unhein bulate rahe. Yeh aqeeda mushrikon ne be-daleel ghadh liya tha jis se Allah bezar tha. Farmata hai (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir rasula) (Surah An-Nahl: 36), yani har ummat mein hum ne Rasool bheje ke tum Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa har ek ki ibadat se alag raho aur farmaya (Wama arsalna min qablika mir rasulin illa noohi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budoon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 25), yani tujh se pehle jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sab ki taraf yehi wahi ki ke mabood-e-barhaq sirf main hi hoon pas tum sab meri hi ibadat karna. Sath hi yeh bhi bayan farma diya ke aasman mein jis qadar farishtay hain khwah woh kitne hi bade martabe wale kyun na hon sab ke sab us ke samne lachar, aajiz aur ghulamon ki manind hain, itna bhi to ikhtiyar nahin ke kisi ki sifarish mein lab hila sakein.

Yeh aqeeda mehez ghalat hai ke woh Allah ke paas aise hain jaise badshahon ke paas ameer-e-umara hote hain ke jis ki woh sifarish kar dein us ka kaam ban jata hai. Is batil aur ghalat aqeede se yeh keh kar mana farmaya ke us ke samne misalein na bayan kiya karo. Allah is se bahut buland-o-bala hai. Qayamat ke roz Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ka sacha faisla kar de ga aur har ek ko us ke aamal ka badla de ga. Un sab ko jama kar ke farishton se sawal kare ga ke kya yeh log tumhein poojte thay? Woh jawab dein ge ke Tu paak hai, yeh nahin balkay hamara wali to Tu hi hai, yeh log to jinnaat ki parastish karte thay aur in mein se aksar ka aqeeda-o-imaan inhi par tha. Allah Ta'ala unhein rah-e-raast nahin dikhata jin ka maqsood Allah par jhoot-o-bohtan bandhna ho aur jin ke dilon mein Allah ki aayaton, us ki nishaniyon aur us ki daleelon se kufr baith gaya ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke aqeede ki nafi ki jo Allah ki aulad thehrate thay, maslan mushrikeen-e-Makkah kehte thay ke farishtay Allah ki ladkiyan hain. Yahood kehte thay Uzair Allah ke ladke hain. Isai guman karte thay ke Isa Allah ke bete hain. Pas farmaya ke jaisa un ka khayal hai agar yahi hota to is amr ke khilaf hota, pas yahan shart na to waqay hone ke liye hai na imkaan ke liye, balkay muhaal ke liye hai aur maqsad sirf un logon ki jahalat bayan karne ka hai. Jaise farmaya (Lau aradna an nattakhiza lahwan lattakhaznahu min laddunna in kunna fa'ileen) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 17) Agar hum in behooda baton ka irada karte to apne paas se hi bana lete agar hum karne wale hi hue. Aur aayat mein hai (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa-ana awwalul aabideen) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81) yani keh de ke agar Rahman ki aulad hoti to main to sab se pehle us ka qail hota. Pas yeh sab aayatein shart ko muhaal ke sath mutaliq karne wali hain, imkaan ya waqoo ke liye nahin balkay matlab yeh hai ke na yeh ho sakta hai na woh ho sakta hai. Allah in sab baton se paak hai, woh Fard, Ahad, Samad aur Wahid hai. Har cheez us ki taahat, farmanbardar, aajiz, mohtaj, faqeer, bekas aur bebas hai. Woh har cheez se ghani hai, sab se be-parwah hai, sab par us ki hukumat aur ghalba hai, zalimon ke in aqaid se aur jahilon ki in baton se us ki zaat mubarra-o-munazza hai.

Woh har cheez se ghani hai, sab se be-parwah hai, sab par us ki hukumat aur ghalba hai, zalimon ke in aqaid se aur jahilon ki in baton se us ki zaat mubarra-o-munazza hai.

Takhliqi-e-Kainat aur Aqeedah-e-Tauheed. Har cheez ka Khaliq, sab ka Malik, sab par hukmran aur sab ka qabiz Allah hi hai. Din raat ka ulat-pher usi ke haath hai, usi ke hukm se intezam ke sath din raat ek dusre ke peeche barabar musalsal chale aa rahe hain. Na woh aage barh sakein na woh peeche reh sakein. Suraj chand ko usne musakhar kar rakha hai, woh apne daure ko pura kar rahe hain, Qayamat tak is intezam mein tum koi farq na paoge. Woh izzat-o-azmat wala, kibriyai aur rif'at wala hai. Gunahgaron ka bakhshnehar, aasiyon par meharban wahi hai. Tum sab ko usne ek hi shakhs yani Hazrat Adam (A.S) se paida kiya hai, phir dekho ke tumhare aapas mein kis qadar ikhtilaf hai. Rang, surat, aawaz, bol-chal, zaban-o-bayan har ek alag alag hai. Hazrat Adam (A.S) se hi unki biwi sahiba Hazrat Hawa (R.A) ko paida kiya. Jaise aur jagah hai ke logo Allah se daro jo tumhara Rabb hai jisne tumhein ek hi nafs se paida kiya hai, usi se uski biwi ko paida kiya, phir bahut se mard-o-aurat phaila diye. Usne tumhare liye aath nar-o-mada chaupaye paida kiye jin ka bayan Surah Maidah ki aayat (Minad-da'ni ithnaini wa minal-ma'zi ithnaini) (Surah Al-An'am: 143) mein hai. Yani bher, bakri, oont, gaye. Woh tumhein tumhari maaon ke peton mein paida karta hai jahan tumhari mukhtalif paidaishein hoti rehti hain; pehle nutfa, phir khoon-e-basta, phir lothra, phir gosht-post, haddi, rag, patthe, phir rooh. Ghaur karo ke woh kitna achha Khaliq hai, teen teen andhere marhalon mein tumhari yeh tarah-tarah ki tabdeeliyon ki paidaish ka her-pher hota rehta hai; reham ki andheri, uske upar ki jhilli ki andheri aur pet ka andhera. Yeh jisne aasman-o-zameen ko aur khud tum ko aur tumhare aglon pichlon ko paida kiya hai, wahi Rabb hai, usi ka Malik hai. Wahi sab mein mutasarif hai, wahi laiq-e-ibadat hai, uske siwa koi aur nahin. Afsos! Na jane tumhari aqlein kahan gayin ke tum uske siwa dusron ki ibadat karne lage.

Farmata hai ke sari makhlooq Allah ki mohtaj hai aur Allah sab se beniaz hai. Hazrat Musa A.S ka farman Quran mein manqool hai ke agar tum aur roo-e-zameen ke sab jandar Allah se kufr karo to Allah ka koi nuqsan nahin, woh sari makhlooq se beparwah aur poori tareefon wala hai. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke ae mere bando! tumhare sab awwal-o-akhir insan-o-jinn mil mila kar badtareen shakhs ka sa dil bana lo to meri badshahat mein koi kami nahin aayegi. Haan, Allah tumhari nashukri se khush nahin, na woh is ka tumhein hukum deta hai aur agar tum us ki shukarguzari karoge to woh is par tum se razamand ho jayega aur tumhein apni aur ne'matein ata farmayega. Har shakhs wahi payega jo us ne kiya ho, ek ke badle doosra pakda na jayega, Allah par koi cheez posheeda nahin. Insan ko dekho ke apni hajat ke waqt to bahut hi aajizi-o-inkisari se Allah ko pukarta hai aur us se faryad karta rehta hai, jaise aur ayat mein hai (Waza massakumud durru fil bahri dalla man tad'oona illaa iyyah, falamma najjakum ilal barri a'radtum, wa kanal insanu kafoora) (17. Al-Isra: 67), yani jab darya aur samundar mein hote hain aur wahan koi aafat aati dekhte hain to jin jin ko Allah ke siwa pukarte the sab ko bhool jate hain aur khalis Allah ko pukarne lagte hain, lekin nijat pate hi munh pher lete hain, insan hai hi nashukra. Pas farmata hai ke jahan dukh dard tal gaya phir to aisa ho jata hai goya museebat ke waqt us ne hamein pukara hi na tha, is dua aur girya-o-zari ko bilkul faramosh kar jata hai. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wa iza massal insana durrun da'a rabbahu muneeban ilaih) (39. Az-Zumar: 8), yani takleef ke waqt to insan hamein uthte baithte, lete har waqt badi huzoor-e-qalbi se pukarta rehta hai lekin is takleef ke hat-te hi woh bhi hum se hat jata hai goya us ne dukh dard ke waqt hamein pukara hi na tha. Balki aafiyat ke waqt Allah ke sath shareek karne lagta hai. Pas Allah farmata hai ke aise log apne kufr se go kuch yunhi sa faida utha lein. Is mein daant hai aur sakht dhamki hai, jaise farmaya keh dijiye ke faida hasil kar lo, aakhri jagah to tumhari jahannam hi hai aur farman hai hum inhe kuch faida denge phir sakht azabon ki taraf bebas kar denge.

Mushrik aur muwahhid barabar nahin. Matlab yeh hai ke jis ki halat yeh ho woh mushrik ke barabar nahin. Jaise farman hai (Laisa sawan min ahlil kitabi) (Surah Al-Imran: 113), yani sab ke sab barabar ke nahin. Ahl-e-Kitab mein woh jamaat bhi hai jo raton ke waqt qayam ki halat mein Aayat-e-Ilahiya ki tilawat karte hain aur sajdon mein pade rehte hain. Qunoot se murad yahan par namaz ka khushoo-o-khuzoo hai. Sirf qayam murad nahin. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) se qanit ke ma'ni muti aur farmanbardar ke hain. Ibn Abbas (R.A) waghera se marwi hai ke 'ana-ul-lail' se murad aadhi raat se hai. Mansoor farmate hain murad Maghrib-o-Isha ke darmiyan ka waqt hai. Qatadah (R.A) waghera farmate hain, awwal, darmiyana aur aakhri shab murad hai. Yeh aabid log ek taraf larzan-o-tarsan hain dusri janib umeedwar aur tama' kunan hain. Nek logon par zindagi mein toh khauf-e-Allah, umeed par ghalib rehta hai, maut ke waqt khauf par umeed ka ghalba ho jata hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ek shakhs ke paas us ke inteqal ke waqt jate hain aur poochte hain ke tu apne aap ko kis halat mein pata hai? Us ne kaha khauf-o-umeed ki halat mein. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya jis shakhs ke dil mein aise waqt yeh dono cheezein jama ho jayen us ki umeed Allah Ta'ala poori karta hai aur us ke khauf se usey nijat ata farmata hai (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghera). Ibn Umar (R.A) ne is aayat ki tilawat kar ke farmaya yeh wasf sirf Hazrat Usman (R.A) mein tha. Fi-al-waq'a aap raat ke waqt bakasrat tahajjud padhte rehte the aur us mein Quran-e-Kareem ki lambi qira'at kiya karte the yahan tak ke kabhi kabhi ek hi rakat mein Quran khatam kar dete the. Jaisa ke Abu Ubaid se marwi hai. Shair kehta hai: Subh ke waqt un ke munh noorani chamak liye hue hote hain kyunke unhon ne tasbeeh-o-tilawat-e-Quran mein raat guzari hai. Nasai waghera mein hadees hai ke jis ne ek raat sau aayatein padh lin us ke nama-e-a'maal mein sari raat ki qunoot likhi jati hai (Musnad waghera). Pas aise log aur mushrik jo Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek thehrate hain kisi tarah ek martabe ke nahin ho sakte, aalim aur be-ilm ka darja ek nahin ho sakta. Har aqalmand par un ka farq zahir hai.

Har haal mein Allah ki ita'at lazmi hai. Allah Ta'ala apne imandar bandon ko apne Rab ki ita'at par jame rehne ka aur har amr mein uski pak zaat ka khayal rakhne ka hukum deta hai ke jis ne is duniya mein neki ki usko is duniya mein aur aane wali aakhirat mein neki hi neki milegi. Tum agar ek jagah Allah ki ibadat istiqlaal se na kar sako to dusri jagah chale jao, Allah ki zameen bahut wasee hai. Ma'asiyat se bhagte raho, shirk ko manzoor na karo. Sabiron ko naap tol aur hisab ke baghair ajar milta hai, jannat inhi ki cheez hai. Mujhe Allah ki khalis ibadat karne ka hukum hua hai aur mujh se yeh bhi farma diya gaya hai ke apni tamam ummat se pehle main khud musalman ho jaoon, apne aap ko Rab ke ahkaam ka aamil aur paband kar loon.

Hukm hota hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke bawajood-e-ke main Allah ka Rasool hoon lekin azaab-e-Ilahi se be-khauf nahin hoon. Agar main apne Rabb ki nafarmani karoon to Qayamat ke din ke azaab se main bhi bach nahin sakta to dusre logon ko to Rabb ki nafarmani se bahut zyada ijtinab karna chahiye. Tum apne deen ka bhi elaan kar do ke main pukhta aur yaksooi wala muwahhid hoon. Tum jis ki chaho ibadat karte raho. Is mein bhi daant-dupat hai na ke ijazat. Poore nuqsan mein woh hain jinhon ne khud apne aap ko aur apne walon ko nuqsan mein phansa diya. Qayamat ke din in mein judai ho jayegi. Agar in ke ahl Jannat mein gaye to yeh dozakh mein jal rahe hain aur in se alag hain aur agar sab Jahannam mein gaye to wahan burai ke sath ek dusre se door rahen aur mehzoon-o-maghmoom hain. Yehi wazeh nuqsan hai. Phir in ka haal jo Jahannam mein hoga us ka bayan ho raha hai ke upar tale aag hi aag hogi. Jaise farmaya (Lahu-m min Jahannama mihādun wa min fawqihim ghawāshin, wa kadhalika najzi-z-zālimīn) (Surah Al-A'raf: 41) yani in ka odhna bichona sab aatish-e-Jahannam se hoga. Zalimon ka yehi badla hai aur aayat mein hai Qayamat wale din unhein neeche upar se azaab ho raha hoga. Aur upar se kaha jayega ke apne aamal ka maza chakho. Yeh is liye zahir-o-bahir kar diya gaya aur khol khol kar is wajah se bayan kiya gaya ke is haqeeqi azaab se jo yaqeenan aane wala hai mere bande khabardar ho jayen aur gunahon aur nafarmaniyon ko chhod dein. Mere bando meri pakad-dakad se mere azaab-o-ghazab se mere inteqam aur badle se darte raho.

Marwi hai ke yeh aayat Zaid bin Amr bin Nufail, Abu Zar aur Salman Farsi (R.A) ke baare mein utri hai lekin sahih yeh hai ke yeh aayat jis tarah in buzurgon par mushtamil hai isi tarah har us shakhs ko shamil karti hai jis mein yeh paak ausaaf hon yani buton se bezari aur Allah ki farmanbardari. Yeh hain jin ke liye donon jahan mein khushiyan hain. Baat samajh kar sun kar jab woh achi ho to us par amal karne wale mustahiq-e-mubarak baad hain. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Kaleem paighambar Hazrat Musa (A.S) se Taurat ke ata farmane ke waqt farmaya tha ise mazbooti se thamo aur apni qaum ko hukum karo ke is ki achai ko mazbooti se tham lein. Aqalmand aur nek raah logon mein bhali baaton ke qabool karne ka sahih maada zaroor hota hai.

Nek a'maal ke hamil logon ke liye mehalat. Farmata hai ke jis ki badbakhti likhi ja chuki hai to use koi bhi rah-e-rast nahin dikha sakta. Kaun hai jo Allah ke gumrah kiye hue ko rah-e-rast dikha sake? Tujh se yeh nahin ho sakta ke tu in ki rehbari kar ke unhein Allah ke azab se bacha sake. Haan nek bakht, nek a'maal, nek aqeeda log Qayamat ke din Jannat ke mehalat mein maze karenge, un bala khanon mein jo kayi kayi manzilon ke hain, tamam saman-e-araish se aarasta hain, wasee aur buland, khubsurat aur jagmag karte hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Jannat mein aise mehal hain jin ka androoni hissa bahar se aur bairooni hissa andar se saaf dikhayi deta hai. Ek a'rabi ne pucha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh kin ke liye hain? Farmaya un ke liye jo narm kalami karein, khana khilayein aur raton ko jab log meethi neend mein hon yeh Allah ke samne khade ho kar gidgidayein, namazein padhein (Tirmidhi waghera). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein farman-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke Jannat mein aise bala khane hain jin ka zahir batin se aur batin zahir se nazar aata hai, inhein Allah Ta'ala ne un ke liye banaya hai jo khana khilayein, kalam ko narm rakhein, pe-dar-pe nafl rozay bakasrat rakhein aur pichli raton ko tahajjud padhein. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai jannati Jannat ke bala khanon ko is tarah dekhenge jaise tum aasman ke sitaron ko dekhte ho aur riwayat mein hai mashriqi maghribi kinaron ke sitare jis tarah tumhein dikhayi dete hain isi tarah Jannat ke woh mehalat tumhein nazar aayenge aur hadith mein hai ke in mehalat ki yeh tareefein sun kar logon ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh to Nabiyon ke liye honge? Aap ne farmaya haan aur Sahaba (R.A) ne kaha ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab tak hum aap ki khidmat mein hazir rehte hain aur aap ke chehre ko dekhte rehte hain us waqt tak to hamare dilon mein narm-e-khiyal rehte hain aur hum aakhirat ki taraf hama-tan mutawajjeh ho jate hain. Lekin jab aap ki majlis se uth kar dunyawi karobar mein phans jate hain, baal bachon mein mashghool ho jate hain to us waqt hamari woh halat nahin rehti. To aap ne farmaya agar tum har waqt isi halat par rehte jo halat tumhari mere samne hoti hai to farishte apne hathon se tum se musafaha karte aur tumhare gharon mein aa kar tum se mulaqatein karte. Suno agar tum gunah hi na karte to Allah aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein taake Allah Ta'ala unhein bakhshe. Hum ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Jannat ki bina kis cheez ki hai? Farmaya ek eent sone ki ek chandi ki. Is ka chuna khalis mushk hai, is ki kankariyan lulu aur yaqoot hain. Is ki mitti zafran hai. Is mein jo dakhil ho gaya woh mala-maal ho gaya. Jis ke baad be-maal hone ka khatra hi nahin. Woh hamesha is mein hi rahega wahan se nikale jane ka imkan hi nahin. Na maut ka khatka hai, un ke kapde galte sadte nahin, un ki jawani dawami hai. Suno teen shakhson ki dua mardood nahin hoti: aadil badshah, rozay dar aur mazloom.

Un ki dua abr par uthai jati hai aur us ke liye aasman ke darwaze khul jate hain aur Allah Rabbul Izzat farmata hai mujhe apni izzat ki qasam main teri zaroor madad karunga agarche kuch muddat ke baad ho. (Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah waghera). In mahalat ke darmiyan chashme beh rahe hain aur woh bhi aise ke jahan chahein pani pahunchayein jab aur jitna chahein bahao rahe. Yeh hai Allah Ta'ala ka wada apne momin bandon se yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala ki zaat wada khilafi se pak hai.

Zindagi ki behtareen misaal. Zameen mein jo paani hai woh darhaqiqat aasman se utra hai. Jaise farman hai ke hum aasman se paani utarte hain yeh paani zameen pee leti hai aur andar hi andar woh phail jata hai. Phir hasb-e-hajat kisi chashma se Allah Ta'ala ise nikalta hai aur chashme jaari ho jate hain. Jo paani zameen ke mail se khara hojata hai woh khara hi rehta hai. Isi tarah aasmani paani barf ki shakal mein paharon par jam jata hai. Jise pahar choos lete hain aur phir un mein se jharne beh nikalte hain. In chashmon aur aabsharon ka paani kheton mein pahunchta hai. Jis se khetiyan lehlahane lagti hain jo mukhtalif qisam ke rang-o-bu ki aur tarah tarah ke maze aur shakal-o-surat ki hoti hain. Phir aakhri waqt mein un ki jawani burhape se aur sabzi zardi se badal jati hai. Phir khushk hojati hai aur kaat li jati hai. Kya is mein aqalmandon ke liye baseerat-o-nasihat nahin? Kya woh itna nahin dekhte ke isi tarah duniya hai. Aaj ek jawan aur khubsurat nazar aati hai kal burhiya aur badsurat hojati hai. Aaj ek shakhs naujawan taqatmand hai kal wahi burha khosat aur kamzor nazar aata hai. Phir aakhir maut ke panje mein phansti hai. Pas aqalmand anjam par nazar rakhein behtar woh hai jis ka anjam behtar ho. Aksar jagah duniya ki zindagi ki misaal barish se paida shuda kheti ke sath di gayi hai jaise (وَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ مَّثَلًا اَصْحٰبَ الْقَرْيَةِ ۘاِذْ جَاۗءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ 13ۚ) (Surah Yaseen: 13) mein. Phir farmata hai jis ka seena Islam ke liye khul gaya, zara socho! Jis ne Rabb ke paas se noor pa liya woh aur sakht seene aur tang dil wala barabar ho sakta hai. Haq par qaim aur haq se door yaksan ho sakte hain? Jaise farmaya (اَوَمَنْ كَانَ مَيْتًا فَاَحْيَيْنٰهُ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهٗ نُوْرًا يَّمْشِيْ بِهٖ فِي النَّاسِ كَمَنْ مَّثَلُهٗ فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ لَيْسَ بِخَارِجٍ مِّنْهَا ۭ كَذٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 122), woh shakhs jo murda tha hum ne use zinda kar diya aur use noor ata farmaya jise apne sath liye hue logon mein chal phir raha hai aur yeh aur woh jo andheriyon mein ghira hua hai jin se chutkara mahal hai. Dono barabar ho sakte hain? Pas yahan bhi bator-e-nasihat bayan farmaya ke jin ke dil Allah ke zikr se narm nahin parte ahkam-e-Ilahi ko manne ke liye nahin khulte Rabb ke samne aajizi nahin karte balkay sangdil aur sakht dil hain un ke liye wail hai kharabi aur afsos-o-hasrat hai yeh bilkul gumrah hain.

Quran-e-Hakim ki taseer. Allah Ta'ala apni is kitab Quran-e-Karim ki tareef mein farmata hai ke is behtareen kitab ko usne nazil farmaya hai jo sab ki sab mutashabih hain aur jis ki ayatein mukarrar hain taake fahm se qareeb-tar hojaye. Ek ayat dusri ke mushabah aur ek harf dusre se milta julta. Is surat ki ayatein is surat se aur is ki is se mili juli. Ek ek zikr kayi kayi jagah aur phir be-ikhtilaf ba'az ayatein ek hi bayan mein ba'az mein jo mazkoor hai us ki zidd ka zikr bhi unhi ke sath hai maslan mominon ke zikr ke sath hi kafiron ka zikr jannat ke sath hi dozakh ka bayan waghera. Dekhiye Abrar ke zikr ke sath hi Fujjar ka bayan hai. Sijjeen ke sath hi Illiyeen ka bayan hai. Muttaqeen ke sath hi Ta'een ka bayan hai. Zikr-e-Jannat ke sath hi tazkira-e-Jahannam hai. Ya'ni ma'ani hain Masani ke aur mutashabih un ayaton ko kehte hain woh to yeh hai aur (Huwal-lazi anzala 'alaikal-kitaba minhu ayatun muhkamatun hunna ummul-kitabi wa ukhara mutashabihat) (Surah Al-Imran: 7) mein aur hi ma'ani hain. Is ki paak aur ba-asar ayaton ka mominon ke dil par noor padta hai woh unhein sunte hi khauf-zada hojate hain sazaon aur dhamkiyon ko sun kar un ka kaleja kapkapane lagta hai rongte khade hojate hain aur intehai aajizi aur bahut hi badi girya-o-zari se un ke dil Allah ki taraf jhuk jate hain us ki Rahmat-o-Lutf par nazrein daal kar ummeedein bandh jati hain. Un ka haal siyah dilon se bilkul judagana hai. Yeh Rabb ke kalam ko nekiyon se sunte hain. Woh gaane bajane par sar dhunste hain. Yeh ayat-e-Qurani se imaan mein badhte hain. Woh unhein sun kar aur kufr ke zeene par chadh-te hain yeh rote hue sajdon mein gir padte hain. Woh mazaq udate hue akadte hain. Farman-e-Quran hai (Innamal-mu'minunal-lazina iza zukirallahu wajilat qulubuhum wa iza tuliyat 'alaihim ayatuhu zadathum imanan wa 'ala rabbihim yatawakkalun) (Surah Al-Anfal: 2), ya'ni yaad-e-Ilahi mominon ke dilon ko dehla deti hai, woh imaan-o-tawakkul mein badh jate hain, namaz-o-zakat-o-khairat ka khayal rakhte hain, sachche ba-imaan yahi hain, darje, maghfirat aur behtareen roziyan yahi payenge aur ayat mein hai ya'ni bhale log ayat-e-Quraniya ko behron andhon ki tarah nahin sunte padhte ke un ki taraf na to sahih tawajjuh ho na irada-e-amal ho balkeh yeh kaan laga kar sunte hain dil laga kar samajhte hain gaur-o-fikr se ma'ani aur matlab tak rasai hasil karte hain. Ab taufiq haath aati hai sajde mein gir padte hain aur tameel ke liye kamar-basta hojate hain. Yeh khud apni samajh se kaam karne wale hote hain dusron ki dekha-dekhi jahalat ke peeche pade nahin rehte. Teesra wasf un mein bar-khilaf dusron ke yeh hai ke Quran ke sunne ke waqt ba-adab rehte hain.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tilawat sun kar Sahaba-e-Kiram ke jism-o-rooh zikr-e-Allah ki taraf jhuk aate thay, un mein khushoo-o-khuzoo paida ho jata tha, lekin yeh na tha ke cheekhne chillane aur haahrak karne lagein aur apni soofiyat jatayein, balkay sabat, sukoon, adab aur khashiyat ke sath Kalam-e-Allah sunte, dil jam'i aur sukoon hasil karte. Isi wajah se mustahiq-e-tareef aur sazawaar-e-tauseef hue (R.A). Abdur Razzaq mein hai ke Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain, Awliya-e-Allah ki sifat yahi hai ke Quran sun kar un ke dil mom ho jayein aur zikr-e-Allah ki taraf woh jhuk jayein, un ke dil dar jayein, un ki aankhein aansu bahayein aur tabiyat mein sukoon paida ho jaye. Yeh nahin ke aql jaati rahe, halat taari ho jaye, nek-o-bad ka hosh na rahe. Yeh bid'atiyon ke af'aal hain ke haa-hoo karne lagte hain aur koodte uchhalte aur kapde phaadte hain, yeh shaitani harkat hai. Zikr-e-Allah se murad wa'da-e-Allah bhi bayan kiya gaya hai. Phir farmata hai, yeh hain sifatein un logon ki jinhein Allah ne hidayat di hai. Un ke khilaf jinhein pao samajh lo ke Allah ne unhein gumrah kar diya hai aur yaqeen rakho ke Rabb jinhein hidayat dena chahe unhein koi raah-e-raast nahin dikha sakta.

Ek woh jise is hangama-khez din mein aman-o-aman hasil ho aur ek woh jise apne munh par azab ke thappar khane padte hon barabar ho sakte hain? Jaise farmaya: "Oundhe munh, munh ke bal chalne wala aur rast-qamat apne pairon seedhi rah chalne wala barabar nahin." In kuffar ko toh Qayamat ke din oundhe munh ghaseeta jayega aur kaha jayega ke aag ka maza chakho. Ek aur aayat mein hai: "Jahannam mein dakhil kiya jane wala badnaseeb achha ya aman-o-aman se Qayamat ka din guzarne wala achha?" Yahan is aayat ka matlab yahi hai lekin ek qisam ka zikr kar ke dusri qisam ke bayan ko chhod diya kyunke isi se woh bhi samajh liya jata hai, yeh baat shu'ara ke kalam mein barabar payi jati hai. Agle logon ne bhi Allah ki baton ko na mana tha aur rasoolon ko jhoota kaha tha, phir dekho ke un par kis tarah un ki be-khabari mein maar padi? Azab-e-Ilahi ne unhein duniya mein bhi zaleel-o-khwar kiya aur aakhirat ke sakht azab bhi un ke liye baqi hain. Pas tumhein darte rehna chahiye ke Ashraf-e-Rusul (ﷺ) ke satane aur na manne ki wajah se tum par kahin un se bhi badtar azab baras na padein. Tum agar zi-ilm ho toh un ke halaat aur tazkire tumhari nasihat ke liye kaafi hain.

Chunancha irshad hai (ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَّثَلًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ 28؀) (Surah Ar-Rum: 28) Allah ne tumhare liye woh misalein bayan farmayi hain jinhein tum khud apne aap mein bohat achi tarah jaante boojhte ho. Ek aur aayat mein hai in misalon ko hum logon ke saamne bayan kar rahe hain ulama hi inhe bakhoobi samajh sakte hain. Yeh Quran faseeh Arabi zaban mein hai jis mein koi kaji aur koi kami nahin, wazeh daleelein aur roshan hujatein hain. Yeh is liye ke ise parh kar sun kar log apna bachao kar lein. Is ke azab ki aayaton ko saamne rakh kar buraiyan chhorein aur is ke sawab ki aayaton ki taraf nazrein rakh kar nek aamal mein mehnat karein. Is ke baad Janab-e-Bari Azza Ismuhu muwahhid aur mushrik ki misal bayan farmata hai ke ek toh woh ghulam jis ke maalik bohat saare hon aur woh bhi aapas mein ek dusre ke mukhalif hon aur dusra woh ghulam jo khalis sirf ek hi shakhs ki malkiyat ka ho, is ke siwa is par dusre kisi ka koi ikhtiyar na ho. Kya yeh dono tumhare nazdeek yaksan hain? Hargiz nahin. Isi tarah muwahhid jo sirf ek Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki hi ibadat karta hai aur mushrik jis ne apne mabood bohat se bana rakhe hain, in dono mein bhi koi nisbat nahin. Kahan yeh mukhlis muwahhid? Kahan yeh dar-ba-dar bhatakne wala mushrik? Is zahir-o-bahir roshan aur saaf misal ke bayan par bhi Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki hamd-o-sana karni chahiye ke us ne apne bandon ko is tarah samjha diya ke mamla bilkul saaf ho jaye. Shirk ki badi aur tauheed ki khoobi har ek ke zehen mein aa jaye. Ab Rabb ke saath wahi shirk karenge jo mehez be-ilm hon jin mein samajh boojh bilkul hi na ho. Is ke baad ki aayat ko Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke inteqal ke baad parh kar phir dusri aayat (وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ اِلَّا رَسُوْلٌ) (Surah Aal-e-Imran: 144) ki aakhir aayat tak tilawat kar ke logon ko bataya tha. Matlab aayat-e-sharifa ka yeh hai ke sab is duniya se jaane wale hain aur aakhirat mein apne Rabb ke paas jama hone wale hain. Wahan Allah Ta'ala mushrikon aur muwahhidon mein saaf faisla kar dega aur haq zahir ho jaye ga. Is se achay faislay wala aur is se zyada ilm wala kaun hai? Imaan, ikhlas aur tauheed-o-sunnat wale nijaat payenge. Shirk-o-kufr, inkar-o-takzeeb wale sakht sazayein uthayenge. Isi tarah jin do shakhson mein jo jhagda aur ikhtilaf duniya mein tha roz-e-qayamat woh Allah-e-Aadil ke saamne pesh ho kar faisal hoga. Is aayat ke nazil hone par Hazrat Zubair (R.A) ne Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke qayamat ke din phir se jhagray honge? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan yaqeenan, toh Hazrat Abdullah ne kaha phir toh sakht mushkil hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki is hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke aayat (ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔــلُنَّ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيْمِ) (Surah At-Takathur: 8).

Ya'ni phir us din tum se Allah ki ne'maton ka sawal kiya jaye ga, ke nazil hone par aap hi ne sawal kiya ke woh kaun si ne'matain hain jin ki babat hum se hisab liya jaye ga? Hum toh khajoorein kha kar aur pani pi kar guzara kar rahe hain. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ab nahin hain toh anqareeb bahut si ne'matain ho jayengi. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Ibn Majah mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan batate hain. Musnad ki isi hadith mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Zubair bin Awam (R.A) ne aayat (Inna-ka mayyitun wa innahum mayyitun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 30) ke nazil hone par poocha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya jo jhagray hamare duniya mein thay woh dobara wahan Qayamat mein dohraye jayenge? Saath hi gunahon ki bhi pursish hogi. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan woh zaroor dohraye jayenge. Aur har shakhs ko us ka haq poora poora dilwaya jaye ga toh aap ne kaha phir toh sakht mushkil kaam hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se pehle padosiyon ke aapas mein jhagray pesh honge aur hadith mein hai us zaat-e-pak ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke sab jhagron ka faisla Qayamat ke din hoga. Yahan tak ke do bakriyan jo lari hongi aur ek ne dusri ko seeng mare honge un ka badla bhi dilwaya jaye ga (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad hi ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke do bakriyon ko aapas mein larte hue dekh kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu-Zarr (R.A) se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho yeh kyun lar rahi hain? Lekin Allah Ta'ala ko us ka ilm hai aur woh Qayamat ke din un mein bhi insaaf kare ga. Bazzar mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain zalim aur khayin badshah se us ki ra'iyat Qayamat ke din jhagda kare gi aur us par woh ghalib aa jaye gi aur Allah ka farman zaroor hoga ke jao ise Jahannam ka ek rukn bana do. Is hadith ke ek rawi Aghlab bin Tameem ka hafiza jaisa chahiye aisa nahin. Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) farmate hain har saccha jhoote se, har mazloom zalim se, har hidayat wala gumrahi wale se, har kamzor zor-awar se us roz jhagray ga. Rooh toh jism ko ilzaam de gi ke tu ne yeh sab buraiyan keen aur jism rooh se kahe ga sari chahat aur shararat teri hi thi. Ek farishta un mein faisla kare ga kahe ga suno ek aankhon wala insaan hai lekin apahaj bilkul loola langra chalne phirne se ma'zoor hai. Dusra aadmi andha hai lekin us ke pair salamat hain chalta phirta hai dono ek baagh mein hain.

Is ke baad jab aapas ke fitnay shuru ho gaye toh hum ne samajh liya ke yahi aapas ke jhagray hain jo Allah ke haan pesh honge. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) farmatay hain Ahl-e-Qibla ghair Ahl-e-Qibla se jhagrein ge aur Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) se marwi hai ke murad Ahl-e-Islam aur Ahl-e-Kufr ka jhagda hai. Lekin hum pehlay hi bayan kar chukay hain ke fi-al-waq'i yeh aayat aam hai. Alhamdulillah! Allah Ta'ala ke lutf-o-karam aur fazl-o-rahm se Tafsir-e-Muhammadi ka teeswan para khatam hua. Allah Ta'ala isay qabool farmaye aur hamari taqseer ki maafi ka sabab is tafsir ko bana de. Hamein apne pak kalam ki tilawat ka zauq, is ke ma'ani ke samajhney ka shauq ata farmaye, ilm-o-amal ki taufiq de, azaab se nijaat de, Jannat-ul-Firdous mein jagah ata farmaye. Ameen!

Aur har shakhs ko us ka haq poora poora dilwaya jaye ga toh aap ne kaha phir toh sakht mushkil kaam hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain sab se pehle padosiyon ke aapas mein jhagray pesh honge aur hadith mein hai us zaat-e-pak ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai ke sab jhagron ka faisla Qayamat ke din hoga. Ek farishta un mein faisla kare ga kahe ga suno ek aankhon wala insaan hai lekin apahaj bilkul loola langra chalne phirne se ma'zoor hai. Rooh toh jism ko ilzaam de gi ke tu ne yeh sab buraiyan keen aur jism rooh se kahe ga sari chahat aur shararat teri hi thi. Ek farishta un mein faisla kare ga kahe ga suno ek aankhon wala insaan hai lekin apahaj bilkul loola langra chalne phirne se ma'zoor hai. Dusra aadmi andha hai lekin us ke pair salamat hain chalta phirta hai dono ek baagh mein hain.

Langra andhay se kehta hai bhai yeh baagh toh mewon aur phalon se lada hua hai lekin mere toh paon nahin jo main ja kar yeh phal tor loon. Andha kehta hai aao mere paon hain tujhe apni peeth par charha leta hoon aur le chalta hoon. Chunancha yeh dono is tarah pohanchay aur jee khol kar phal toray batao in dono mein mujrim kaun hai? Jism-o-rooh dono jawab detay hain ke jurm dono ka hai. Farishta kehta hai bas ab toh tum ne apna faisla aap kar diya. Ya'ni jism goya sawari hai aur rooh is par sawar hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) farmatay hain ke is aayat ke nazil honay par hum ta'ajjub mein thay ke hum mein aur Ahl-e-Kitab mein toh jhagda hai hi nahin phir aakhir roz-e-qayamat mein kis se jhagray honge? Is ke baad jab aapas ke fitnay shuru ho gaye toh hum ne samajh liya ke yahi aapas ke jhagray hain jo Allah ke haan pesh honge. Abu Al-Aliyah (R.H) farmatay hain Ahl-e-Qibla ghair Ahl-e-Qibla se jhagrein ge aur Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) se marwi hai ke murad Ahl-e-Islam aur Ahl-e-Kufr ka jhagda hai. Lekin hum pehlay hi bayan kar chukay hain ke fi-al-waq'i yeh aayat aam hai. Alhamdulillah! Allah Ta'ala ke lutf-o-karam aur fazl-o-rahm se Tafsir-e-Muhammadi ka teeswan para khatam hua. Allah Ta'ala isay qabool farmaye aur hamari taqseer ki maafi ka sabab is tafsir ko bana de. Hamein apne pak kalam ki tilawat ka zauq, is ke ma'ani ke samajhney ka shauq ata farmaye, ilm-o-amal ki taufiq de, azaab se nijaat de, Jannat-ul-Firdous mein jagah ata farmaye. Ameen!

Mushrikeen ki saza aur muwahhideen ki jaza. Mushrikeen ne Allah par bahut jhoot bola tha aur tarah-tarah ke ilzaam lagaye thay, kabhi us ke saath dusre mabood batate thay, kabhi farishton ko Allah ki ladkiyan shumar karne lagte thay, kabhi makhlooq mein se kisi ko us ka beta keh diya karte thay, jin tamam baaton se us ki buland-o-bala zaat paak aur bartar thi, saath hi un mein dusri bad-khaslat yeh bhi thi ke jo haq Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ki zabani Allah Ta'ala nazil farmata yeh use bhi jhutlate, pas farmaya ke yeh sab se badh kar zalim hain. Phir jo saza unhein honi hai us se unhein aagah kar diya ke aise logon ka thikana Jahannam hi hai. Jo marte dam tak inkar-o-takzeeb par hi rahein. Un ki bad-khaslat aur saza ka zikr kar ke phir mominon ki nek-kho aur un ki jaza ka zikr farmata hai ke jo sachai ko laya aur use sacha mana yani Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aur Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aur har woh shakhs jo kalma-e-tauheed ka iqraari ho. Aur tamam Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) aur un ki manne wali un ki musalman ummat. Yeh Qayamat ke din yahi kahenge ke jo tum ne hamein diya aur jo farmaya hum isi par amal karte rahe. Khud Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi is aayat mein dakhil hain. Aap bhi sachai ke lane wale, agle rasoolon ki tasdeeq karne wale aur aap par jo kuch nazil hua tha use manne wale thay aur saath hi yahi wasf tamam imandaron ka tha ke woh Allah par, farishton par, kitabon par aur rasoolon par iman rakhne wale thay. Rabee bin Anas ki qiraat mein (وَالَّذِيْ جَاۗءَ بالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهٖٓ اُولٰۗىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّـقُوْنَ 33؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 33) hai. Hazrat Abdur-Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam farmate hain sachai ko lane wale Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain aur use sach manne wale musalman hain yahi muttaqi, parhezgar aur parsa hain. Jo Allah se darte rahe aur shirk-o-kufr se bachte rahe. Un ke liye Jannat mein jo woh chahein sab kuch hai. Jab talab karenge payenge. Yahi badla hai un paak-baaz logon ka, Rabb un ki buraiyan to maaf farma deta hai aur nekiyan qabool kar leta hai. Jaise dusri aayat mein (اُولٰۗىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ اَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَنْ سَـيِّاٰتِهِمْ فِيْٓ اَصْحٰبِ الْجَــنَّةِ ۭ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِيْ كَانُوْا يُوْعَدُوْنَ 16؀) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 16) yeh woh log hain ke un ki nekiyan hum qabool kar lete hain aur buraiyon se darguzar farma lete hain. Yeh jannaton mein rahenge. Unhein bilkul sacha aur sahih-sahih wada diya jata hai.

Bharosa ke laiq sirf Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki zaat hai. Ek qiraat mein (Alaysallahu bi-kaafin 'abdahu, wa yukhawwifunaka billadhina min dunihi, wa may-yudlilillahu famalahu min haad) (Surah Az-Zumar: 36) yani Allah Ta'ala apne har bande ko kaafi hai. Isi par har shakhs ko bharosa rakhna chahiye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke usne najaat paali jo Islam ki hidayat diya gaya aur ba-qadr-e-zaroorat rozi diya gaya aur qana'at bhi naseeb hui (Tirmidhi waghera). Ae Nabi (ﷺ) yeh log tujhe Allah ke siwa auron se dara rahe hain. Yeh unki jahalat-o-zalalat hai, aur Allah jise gumrah kar de use koi raah nahin dikha sakta, jis tarah Allah ke raah dikhaye hue shakhs ko koi behka nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala buland martaba wala hai us par bharosa karne wale ka koi kuch bigad nahin sakta aur uski taraf jhuk jaane wala kabhi mehroom nahin rehta. Is se badh kar izzat wala koi nahin. Isi tarah is se badh kar inteqam par qadir bhi koi nahin. Jo uske saath kufr-o-shirk karte hain, uske Rasoolon se ladte bhidte hain yaqeenan woh unhein sakht sazayein dega. Mushrikeen ki mazeed jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke bawajood Allah Ta'ala ko Khaliq-e-Kul manne ke phir bhi aise maboodan-e-batila ki parastish karte hain jo kisi nafa-o-nuqsan ke maalik nahin jinhein kisi amr ka koi ikhtiyar nahin. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai Allah ko yaad kar woh teri hifazat karega. Allah ko yaad rakh tu use har waqt apne paas payega. Aasani ke waqt Rabb ki nematon ka shukr-guzar reh, sakhti ke waqt woh tere kaam aayega. Jab kuch maang to Allah hi se maang aur jab madad talab kar to usi se madad talab kar. Yaqeen rakh kar agar tamam duniya mil kar tujhe koi nuqsan pahunchana chahe aur Allah ka irada na ho to woh sab tujhe zara sa bhi nuqsan nahin pahuncha sakte aur sab jama ho kar tujhe koi nafa pahunchana chahein jo Allah ne muqaddar mein na likha ho to hargiz nahin pahuncha sakta. Sahife khushk ho chuke, qalamein utha li gayin. Yaqeen aur shukr ke saath nekiyon mein mashghool raha kar, takleefon mein sabr karne par badi nekiyan milti hain. Madad sabr ke saath hai. Gham-o-ranj ke saath hi khushi aur farakhi hai. Har sakhti apne andar aasani ko liye hue hai (Ibn Abi Hatim). Tu keh de ke mujhe Allah bas hai. Bharosa karne wale usi ki paak zaat par bharosa karte hain. Jaise ke Hazrat Hud (A.S) ne apni qoum ko jawab diya tha jabke unhone kaha tha ke ae Hud hamare khayal se to tumhein hamare kisi mabood ne kisi kharabi mein mubtala kar diya hai. To aap ne farmaya main Allah ko gawah karta hoon aur tum bhi gawah raho ke main tumhare tamam maboodan-e-batil se bezar hoon. Tum sab mil kar mere saath jo daao-ghaat tum se ho sakte hain sab kar lo aur mujhe mutlaq mohlat na do. Suno mera tawakkul mere Rabb par hai jo dar-asal tum sab ka bhi Rabb hai. Roo-e-zameen par jitne chalne phirne wale hain sab ki chotiyan uske haath mein hain. Mera Rabb Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par hai.

Rasoolullah Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jo shakhs sab se zyada qawi hona chahe woh Allah par bharosa rakhe aur jo sab se zyada ghani banna chahe woh us cheez par jo Allah ke haath mein hai zyada etemaad rakhe ba-nisbat us cheez ke jo khud us ke haath mein hai aur jo sab se zyada buzurg hona chahe woh Allah Azzawajal se darta rahe. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Phir mushrikeen ko daant-te hue farmata hai ke achha tum apne tareeqe par amal karte chale jao. Main apne tareeqe par aamil hoon. Tumhein anqareeb maloom ho jayega ke duniya mein zaleel-o-khwar kaun hota hai? Aur aakhirat ke daimi azaab mein giraftar kaun hota hai? Allah hamein mehfooz rakhe.

In kafiron ki yeh halat hai ke tauheed ka kalma sunna unhein napasand hai. Allah Ta'ala ki wahdaniyat ka zikr sun kar un ke dilon mein tangi ho jati hai. Is ka sunna bhi unhein pasand nahin. Un ka jee is mein nahin lagta. Kufr-o-takabbur unhein rok deta hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai yani un se jab kaha jata tha ke Allah ek ke siwa koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin toh yeh takabbur karte the aur manne se jee churate the. Chunke un ke dil haq ke munkir hain is liye batil ko bahut jald qabool kar lete hain. Jahan buton ka aur dusre Allah ka zikr aaya, un ki baachhein khil gayin.

Mushrikeen ki muzammat. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ki muzammat bayan farmata hai ke woh buton aur maboodan-e-batila ko apna sifarishi aur shafi samajhte hain, is ki na koi daleel hai na hujjat aur darasal unhein na kuch ikhtiyar hai na aql-o-shaoor. Na un ki aankhein na un ke kaan, woh toh patthar aur jamadat hain jo haiwanon mein darja-ha badtar hain. Is liye apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko hukum diya ke un se keh do, koi nahin jo Allah ke samne lab hila sake, aawaz utha sake jab tak ke us ki marzi na pa le aur ijazat hasil na kar le, sari shafa'aton ka malik wahi hai. Subh-o-Sham ke ba'az wazaif. Mushrikeen ko jo nafrat tauheed se hai aur jo mohabbat shirk se hai use bayan farma kar apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se Allah Ta'ala wahdahu la sharika lahu farmata hai ke tu sirf Allah Ta'ala wahid ko hi pukar jo aasman-o-zameen ka khaliq hai aur us waqt usne inhe paida kiya hai jabke na yeh kuch thay na unka koi namuna tha. Woh zahir-o-batin chhupe khule ka aalim hai. Yeh log jo jo ikhtilafat apne aapas mein karte thay sab ka faisla us din hoga jab yeh qabron se niklein aur maidan-e-qayamat mein aayenge. Hazrat Abu Salama bin Abdur Rahman (R.H) Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se daryaft karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tahajjud ki namaz ko kis dua se shuru karte thay? Aap farmate hain is dua se (tarjuma) yani Allah ae Jibraeel, Mikaeel aur Israfeel ke Rabb ae aasman-o-zameen ko be-namune ke paida karne wale ise hazir-o-ghaib kiye jane wale tu hi apne bandon ke ikhtilaf ka faisla karne wala hai jis jis cheez mein ikhtilaf kiya gaya hai tu mujhe un sab mein apne fazl se haq raah dikha tu jise chahe seedhi raah ki rehnumai karta hai (Muslim). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo banda is dua ko padhe Allah Ta'ala qayamat ke din apne farishton se farmayega ke mere is bande ne mujhse ahd liya hai is ahd ko pura karo. Chunancha ise jannat mein pahuncha diya jayega. Woh dua yeh hai (tarjuma) yani ae Allah ae aasman-o-zameen ko be-namune ke paida karne wale ae ghaib-o-hazir ke janne wale main is duniya mein tujhse ahd karta hoon ke meri gawahi hai ke tere siwa koi mabood nahin tu akela hai tera koi sharik nahin aur meri yeh bhi shahadat hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tere bande aur tere Rasool hain. Tu agar mujhe meri hi taraf sonp dega to main burai se qareeb aur bhalai se door pad jaunga. Allah mujhe sirf teri rahmat hi ka sahara aur bharosa hai pas tu bhi mujhse ahd kar jise tu qayamat ke din pura kare yaqeenan tu ahd-shikan nahin. Is hadith ke rawi Suhail farmate hain ke maine Qasim bin Abdur Rahman se jab kaha ke Aun is tarah yeh hadith bayan karte hain to aap ne farmaya SubhanAllah hamari to parda-nashin bachiyon ko bhi yeh hadith yaad hai (Musnad Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr ne ek kagaz nikala aur farmaya ke yeh dua hamein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sikhayi hai (tarjuma) yani ae Allah ae aasman-o-zameen ko be-namuna paida karne wale chupi khuli ke janne wale tu har cheez ka Rabb hai aur har cheez ka mabood hai. Main gawahi deta hoon ke tere siwa koi mabood nahin tu akela hai tera koi sharik nahin aur Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tere bande aur tere Rasool hain aur farishtay bhi yahi gawahi dete hain. Main shaitan se aur uske shirk se teri panah mein aata hoon. Main tujhse panah talab karta hoon ke main apni jaan par koi gunah karoon ya kisi aur musalman ki taraf kisi gunah ko le jaoon. Hazrat Abu Abdur Rahman (R.A) farmate hain is dua ko Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr ko sikhaya tha ise sone ke waqt padha karte thay.

(Musnad-e-Imam Ahmad) aur riwayat mein hai ke Abu Rashid Habrani ne koi hadith sunne ki khwahish Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr se ki to Hazrat Abdullah ne ek kitab nikal kar unke samne rakh di aur farmaya yeh hai jo mujhe Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne likhwai hai. Main ne dekha to us mein likha hua tha ke Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main subh-o-sham kya parhoon? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh parho: (Allahumma fatiras-samawati wal-ard, 'alimul-ghaibi wash-shahadah, la ilaha illa anta, rabba kulli shai'in wa malikahu, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa sharrish-shaitani wa shirkihi, au aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, au ajurrahu ila muslim). (Tirmidhi waghairah). Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain mujhe is dua ke parhne ka Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne subh sham aur sote waqt hukum diya hai. Dusri aayat mein zalimon se murad mushrikeen hain. Farmata hai ke agar unke paas roo-e-zameen ke khazane utne hi aur hon to bhi yeh Qayamat ke badtareen azab ke badle unhein apne fidiye mein aur apni jaan ke badle mein dene ke liye tayyar ho jayenge. Lekin us din koi fidiya aur badla qabool na kiya jayega go zameen bhar kar sona dein jaise ke aur aayat mein bayan farma diya hai. Aaj Allah ke woh azab unke samne aayenge ke kabhi unhein unka khayal bhi na guzra tha. Jo jo haram kariyaan, badkariyaan, gunah aur buraiyan unhon ne duniya mein ki thin ab sab ki sab apne aage majood payenge. Duniya mein jis saza ka zikr sun kar mazaq karte the aaj woh unhein charon taraf se gher legi.

Insaan ka nashukra pan. Allah Ta'ala insaan ki halat ko bayan farmata hai ke mushkil ke waqt toh woh aah-o-zari shuru kar deta hai, Allah ki taraf puri tarah raaje' aur raghib ho jata hai, lekin jahan mushkil tal gayi jahan rahat-o-nemat hasil hui yeh sarkash-o-mutakabbir bana. Aur akarta hua kehne laga ke yeh toh Allah ke zimme mera haq tha. Main Allah ke nazdeek is ka mustahiq tha hi. Meri apni aql-mandi aur khush-tadbeeri ki wajah se is nemat ko main ne hasil kiya hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai baat yun nahin balkay darasal yeh hamari taraf ki aazmaish hai go hamain azal se ilm hasil hai lekin taham hum isay zuhoor mein lana chahte hain aur dekhte hain ke is nemat ka yeh shukr ada karta hai ya nashukri? Lekin yeh log be-ilm hain. Daaway karte hain munh se baat nikal dete hain lekin asliyat se be-khabar hain, yahi daawa aur yahi qaul in se pehle ke logon ne bhi kiya aur kaha, lekin un ka qaul sahih sabit na hua aur un nematon ne, kisi aur cheez ne aur un ke aamaal ne unhain koi nafa na diya, jis tarah un par wabaal toot para usi tarah in par bhi ek din un ki bad-aamaliyon ka wabaal aa pare ga aur yeh Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte. Na thaka aur hara sakte hain. Jaise ke Qaroon se us ki qaum ne kaha tha ke is qadar akar nahin Allah Ta'ala khud-pasandon ko mehboob nahin rakhta. Allah ki di hui nematon ko kharch kar ke aakhirat ki tayari kar aur wahan ka saaman muhayya kar. Is duniya mein bhi faida uthata reh aur jaise Allah ne tere sath sulook kiya hai, tu bhi logon ke sath ehsaan karta reh. Zameen mein fasaad karne wala mat ban Allah Ta'ala mufsidon se mohabbat nahin karta. Is par Qaroon ne jawab diya ke in tamam nematon aur jaah-o-daulat ko main ne apni danai aur ilm-o-hunar se hasil kiya hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai kya isay yeh maloom nahin ke is se pehle is se zyada quwwat aur is se zyada jama-jatha walon ko main ne halak-o-barbad kar diya hai, mujrim apne gunahon ke bare mein pooche na jayenge. Al-gharaz maal-o-aulad par phool kar Allah ko bhool jana yeh shewa-e-kufr hai. Kuffar ka qaul tha ke hum maal-o-aulad mein zyada hain hamain azaab nahin hoga, kya unhain ab tak yeh maloom nahin ke rizq ka maalik Allah Ta'ala hai jis ke liye chahe kushadgi kare aur jis par chahe tangi kare. Is mein imaan walon ke liye tarah-tarah ki ibratein aur daleelein hain.

Is duniya mein bhi faida uthata reh aur jaise Allah ne tere sath sulook kiya hai, tu bhi logon ke sath ehsaan karta reh. Zameen mein fasaad karne wala mat ban Allah Ta'ala mufsidon se mohabbat nahin karta. Is par Qaroon ne jawab diya ke in tamam nematon aur jaah-o-daulat ko main ne apni danai aur ilm-o-hunar se hasil kiya hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai kya isay yeh maloom nahin ke is se pehle is se zyada quwwat aur is se zyada jama-jatha walon ko main ne halak-o-barbad kar diya hai, mujrim apne gunahon ke bare mein pooche na jayenge. Al-gharaz maal-o-aulad par phool kar Allah ko bhool jana yeh shewa-e-kufr hai. Kuffar ka qaul tha ke hum maal-o-aulad mein zyada hain hamain azaab nahin hoga, kya unhain ab tak yeh maloom nahin ke rizq ka maalik Allah Ta'ala hai jis ke liye chahe kushadgi kare aur jis par chahe tangi kare. Is mein imaan walon ke liye tarah-tarah ki ibratein aur daleelein hain.

Insaan ka nashukra pan. Allah Ta'ala insaan ki halat ko bayan farmata hai ke mushkil ke waqt toh woh aah-o-zari shuru kar deta hai, Allah ki taraf puri tarah raaje' aur raghib ho jata hai, lekin jahan mushkil tal gayi jahan rahat-o-nemat hasil hui yeh sarkash-o-mutakabbir bana. Aur akarta hua kehne laga ke yeh toh Allah ke zimme mera haq tha. Main Allah ke nazdeek is ka mustahiq tha hi. Meri apni aql-mandi aur khush-tadbeeri ki wajah se is nemat ko main ne hasil kiya hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai baat yun nahin balkay darasal yeh hamari taraf ki aazmaish hai go hamain azal se ilm hasil hai lekin taham hum isay zuhoor mein lana chahte hain aur dekhte hain ke is nemat ka yeh shukr ada karta hai ya nashukri? Lekin yeh log be-ilm hain. Daaway karte hain munh se baat nikal dete hain lekin asliyat se be-khabar hain, yahi daawa aur yahi qaul in se pehle ke logon ne bhi kiya aur kaha, lekin un ka qaul sahih sabit na hua aur un nematon ne, kisi aur cheez ne aur un ke aamaal ne unhain koi nafa na diya, jis tarah un par wabaal toot para usi tarah in par bhi ek din un ki bad-aamaliyon ka wabaal aa pare ga aur yeh Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte. Tauba tamam gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Is aayat mein tamam nafarmanon ko go woh mushrik-o-kafir bhi hon tauba ki dawat di gayi hai aur bataya gaya hai ke Allah ki zaat Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Woh har taib ki tauba qabool karta hai. Har jhukne wali ki taraf mutawajja hota hai, tauba karne wale ke agle gunah bhi maaf farma deta hai go woh kaise hi hon, kitne hi hon, kabhi ke hon. Is aayat ko baghair tauba ke gunahon ki bakhshish ke ma'ani mein lena sahih nahin is liye ke shirk baghair tauba ke bakhsha nahin jata. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hamesha khula hua rehta hai aur woh bahut hi wasee hai. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai (الم یعلموا ان اللہ ھو یقبل التوبتہ عن عبادہ) kya log nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai. Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke baad bhi jo shakhs Allah ke bandon ko tauba se mayoos kare, woh Allah Azzawajal ki Kitab ka munkir hai. Lekin ise samajh lo ke jab tak Allah kisi bande par apni meherbani se ruju na farmaye use tauba naseeb nahin hoti. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi ke mere gunahgar bandon se keh do woh meri rahmat se mayoos na hon. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ki hadith mein hai ke jo log ba-wajah apni kamzori ke kuffar ki takleefein bardasht na karsakne ki wajah se apne deen mein fitne mein par gaye hum us ki nisbat aapas mein kehte the ke Allah Ta'ala un ki koi neki aur tauba qabool na farmaye ga un logon ne Allah ko pehchan kar phir kufr ko le liya aur kafiron ki sakhti ko bardasht na kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai. Badkaron ke yeh teeno qaul bayan farmaye aur dusri jagah yeh khabar de di ke agar yeh wapas duniya mein bhi bheje jayen to bhi hidayat ko ikhtiyar na karenge. Balkay jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karne lagenge aur yahan jo kehte hain sab jhoot niklega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai har jahannami ko us ki jannat ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai kaash ke Allah mujhe hidayat deta. Yeh is liye ke use hasrat-o-afsos ho. Aur isi tarah har jannati ko us ki jahannam ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai ke agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala hidayat na deta to woh jannat mein na aa sakta.

Yeh is liye ke woh shukr aur ehsan ke manne mein aur barh jaye, jab gunahgar log duniya ki taraf lautne ki aarzu karenge aur Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq na karne ki hasrat karenge aur Allah ke rasoolon ko na manne par karhne lagenge to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ab nidamat la-hasil hai, pachtawa be-sood hai. Duniya mein hi mein to apni aayatein utaar chuka tha, apni daleelein qaim kar chuka tha, lekin tu unhein jhutlata raha aur un ki tabedari se takabbur karta raha, un ka munkir raha. Kufr ikhtiyar kiya, ab kuch nahin ho sakta.

Tauba tamam gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Is aayat mein tamam nafarmanon ko go woh mushrik-o-kafir bhi hon tauba ki dawat di gayi hai aur bataya gaya hai ke Allah ki zaat Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Woh har taib ki tauba qabool karta hai. Har jhukne wali ki taraf mutawajja hota hai, tauba karne wale ke agle gunah bhi maaf farma deta hai go woh kaise hi hon, kitne hi hon, kabhi ke hon. Is aayat ko baghair tauba ke gunahon ki bakhshish ke ma'ani mein lena sahih nahin is liye ke shirk baghair tauba ke bakhsha nahin jata. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hamesha khula hua rehta hai aur woh bahut hi wasee hai. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai (الم یعلموا ان اللہ ھو یقبل التوبتہ عن عبادہ) kya log nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai. Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke baad bhi jo shakhs Allah ke bandon ko tauba se mayoos kare, woh Allah Azzawajal ki Kitab ka munkir hai. Lekin ise samajh lo ke jab tak Allah kisi bande par apni meherbani se ruju na farmaye use tauba naseeb nahin hoti. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi ke mere gunahgar bandon se keh do woh meri rahmat se mayoos na hon. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ki hadith mein hai ke jo log ba-wajah apni kamzori ke kuffar ki takleefein bardasht na karsakne ki wajah se apne deen mein fitne mein par gaye hum us ki nisbat aapas mein kehte the ke Allah Ta'ala un ki koi neki aur tauba qabool na farmaye ga un logon ne Allah ko pehchan kar phir kufr ko le liya aur kafiron ki sakhti ko bardasht na kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai.
