Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke baad bhi jo shakhs Allah ke bandon ko tauba se mayoos kare, woh Allah Azzawajal ki Kitab ka munkir hai. Lekin ise samajh lo ke jab tak Allah kisi bande par apni meherbani se ruju na farmaye use tauba naseeb nahin hoti. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi ke mere gunahgar bandon se keh do woh meri rahmat se mayoos na hon. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ki hadith mein hai ke jo log ba-wajah apni kamzori ke kuffar ki takleefein bardasht na karsakne ki wajah se apne deen mein fitne mein par gaye hum us ki nisbat aapas mein kehte the ke Allah Ta'ala un ki koi neki aur tauba qabool na farmaye ga un logon ne Allah ko pehchan kar phir kufr ko le liya aur kafiron ki sakhti ko bardasht na kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai. Badkaron ke yeh teeno qaul bayan farmaye aur dusri jagah yeh khabar de di ke agar yeh wapas duniya mein bhi bheje jayen to bhi hidayat ko ikhtiyar na karenge. Balkay jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karne lagenge aur yahan jo kehte hain sab jhoot niklega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai har jahannami ko us ki jannat ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai kaash ke Allah mujhe hidayat deta. Yeh is liye ke use hasrat-o-afsos ho. Aur isi tarah har jannati ko us ki jahannam ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai ke agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala hidayat na deta to woh jannat mein na aa sakta.

Yeh is liye ke woh shukr aur ehsan ke manne mein aur barh jaye, jab gunahgar log duniya ki taraf lautne ki aarzu karenge aur Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq na karne ki hasrat karenge aur Allah ke rasoolon ko na manne par karhne lagenge to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ab nidamat la-hasil hai, pachtawa be-sood hai. Duniya mein hi mein to apni aayatein utaar chuka tha, apni daleelein qaim kar chuka tha, lekin tu unhein jhutlata raha aur un ki tabedari se takabbur karta raha, un ka munkir raha. Kufr ikhtiyar kiya, ab kuch nahin ho sakta.

Tauba tamam gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Is aayat mein tamam nafarmanon ko go woh mushrik-o-kafir bhi hon tauba ki dawat di gayi hai aur bataya gaya hai ke Allah ki zaat Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Woh har taib ki tauba qabool karta hai. Har jhukne wali ki taraf mutawajja hota hai, tauba karne wale ke agle gunah bhi maaf farma deta hai go woh kaise hi hon, kitne hi hon, kabhi ke hon. Is aayat ko baghair tauba ke gunahon ki bakhshish ke ma'ani mein lena sahih nahin is liye ke shirk baghair tauba ke bakhsha nahin jata. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi ke mere gunahgar bandon se keh do woh meri rahmat se mayoos na hon. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ki hadith mein hai ke jo log ba-wajah apni kamzori ke kuffar ki takleefein bardasht na karsakne ki wajah se apne deen mein fitne mein par gaye hum us ki nisbat aapas mein kehte the ke Allah Ta'ala un ki koi neki aur tauba qabool na farmaye ga un logon ne Allah ko pehchan kar phir kufr ko le liya aur kafiron ki sakhti ko bardasht na kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai. Badkaron ke yeh teeno qaul bayan farmaye aur dusri jagah yeh khabar de di ke agar yeh wapas duniya mein bhi bheje jayen to bhi hidayat ko ikhtiyar na karenge. Balkay jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karne lagenge aur yahan jo kehte hain sab jhoot niklega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai har jahannami ko us ki jannat ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai kaash ke Allah mujhe hidayat deta. Yeh is liye ke use hasrat-o-afsos ho. Aur isi tarah har jannati ko us ki jahannam ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai ke agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala hidayat na deta to woh jannat mein na aa sakta.

Yeh is liye ke woh shukr aur ehsan ke manne mein aur barh jaye, jab gunahgar log duniya ki taraf lautne ki aarzu karenge aur Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq na karne ki hasrat karenge aur Allah ke rasoolon ko na manne par karhne lagenge to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ab nidamat la-hasil hai, pachtawa be-sood hai. Duniya mein hi mein to apni aayatein utaar chuka tha, apni daleelein qaim kar chuka tha, lekin tu unhein jhutlata raha aur un ki tabedari se takabbur karta raha, un ka munkir raha. Kufr ikhtiyar kiya, ab kuch nahin ho sakta.

Tauba tamam gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Is aayat mein tamam nafarmanon ko go woh mushrik-o-kafir bhi hon tauba ki dawat di gayi hai aur bataya gaya hai ke Allah ki zaat Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Woh har taib ki tauba qabool karta hai. Har jhukne wali ki taraf mutawajja hota hai, tauba karne wale ke agle gunah bhi maaf farma deta hai go woh kaise hi hon, kitne hi hon, kabhi ke hon. Is aayat ko baghair tauba ke gunahon ki bakhshish ke ma'ani mein lena sahih nahin is liye ke shirk baghair tauba ke bakhsha nahin jata. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hamesha khula hua rehta hai aur woh bahut hi wasee hai. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai (الم یعلموا ان اللہ ھو یقبل التوبتہ عن عبادہ) kya log nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai. Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai. Badkaron ke yeh teeno qaul bayan farmaye aur dusri jagah yeh khabar de di ke agar yeh wapas duniya mein bhi bheje jayen to bhi hidayat ko ikhtiyar na karenge. Balkay jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karne lagenge aur yahan jo kehte hain sab jhoot niklega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai har jahannami ko us ki jannat ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai kaash ke Allah mujhe hidayat deta. Yeh is liye ke use hasrat-o-afsos ho. Aur isi tarah har jannati ko us ki jahannam ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai ke agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala hidayat na deta to woh jannat mein na aa sakta.

Yeh is liye ke woh shukr aur ehsan ke manne mein aur barh jaye, jab gunahgar log duniya ki taraf lautne ki aarzu karenge aur Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq na karne ki hasrat karenge aur Allah ke rasoolon ko na manne par karhne lagenge to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ab nidamat la-hasil hai, pachtawa be-sood hai. Duniya mein hi mein to apni aayatein utaar chuka tha, apni daleelein qaim kar chuka tha, lekin tu unhein jhutlata raha aur un ki tabedari se takabbur karta raha, un ka munkir raha. Kufr ikhtiyar kiya, ab kuch nahin ho sakta.

Tauba tamam gunahon ki maafi ka zariya. Is aayat mein tamam nafarmanon ko go woh mushrik-o-kafir bhi hon tauba ki dawat di gayi hai aur bataya gaya hai ke Allah ki zaat Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Woh har taib ki tauba qabool karta hai. Har jhukne wali ki taraf mutawajja hota hai, tauba karne wale ke agle gunah bhi maaf farma deta hai go woh kaise hi hon, kitne hi hon, kabhi ke hon. Is aayat ko baghair tauba ke gunahon ki bakhshish ke ma'ani mein lena sahih nahin is liye ke shirk baghair tauba ke bakhsha nahin jata. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hamesha khula hua rehta hai aur woh bahut hi wasee hai. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai (الم یعلموا ان اللہ ھو یقبل التوبتہ عن عبادہ) kya log nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai. Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke baad bhi jo shakhs Allah ke bandon ko tauba se mayoos kare, woh Allah Azzawajal ki Kitab ka munkir hai. Lekin ise samajh lo ke jab tak Allah kisi bande par apni meherbani se ruju na farmaye use tauba naseeb nahin hoti. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke ba'az mushrikeen jo qatl-o-zina ke bhi murtakib thay hazir-e-khidmat-e-Nabwi ho kar arz karte hain ke yeh aap ki baatein aur aap ka deen hamein har lihaz se achha aur sacha maloom hota hai. Lekin yeh bade bade gunah jo hum se ho chuke hain un ka kaffara kya hoga? Is par aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا 68؀ۙ) (25. Al-Furqan: 68), yeh aur aayat nazil hui. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe sari duniya aur us ki har cheez ke milne se itni khushi na hui jitni is aayat ke nazil hone se hui hai. Ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke jis ne shirk kiya ho? Aap ne thodi der ki khamoshi ke baad farmaya khabardar raho jis ne shirk bhi kiya ho, teen martaba yahi farmaya. Musnad ki ek aur hadith mein hai ke ek boodha bada shakhs lakdi tikata hua Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kaha ke mere chhote mote gunah bahut saare hain kya mujhe bhi bakhsha jayega? Aap ne farmaya kya tu Allah ki tauheed ki gawahi nahin deta? Us ne kaha haan aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ki gawahi bhi deta hoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tere chhote mote gunah maaf hain. Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi wagaira mein hai Hazrat Asma (R.A) farmati hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko suna aap is aayat ki tilawat isi tarah farma rahe thay (اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ 46؀) (11. Hud: 46) aur is aayat ko is tarah padhte hue suna (قُلْ يٰعِبَادِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسْرَفُوْا عَلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوْا مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ اللّٰهِ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوْبَ جَمِيْعًا ۭ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ 53؀) (39. Az-Zumar: 53). Pas in tamam ahadith se sabit ho raha hai ke tauba se sab gunah maaf ho jate hain. Bande ko Rahmat-e-Rabb se mayoos na hona chahiye. Go gunah kitne hi bade aur kitne hi kasrat se hon. Tauba aur rahmat ka darwaza hamesha khula hua rehta hai aur woh bahut hi wasee hai. Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai (الم یعلموا ان اللہ ھو یقبل التوبتہ عن عبادہ) kya log nahin jante ke Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ki tauba qabool farmata hai. Aur farmaya (وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ سُوْۗءًا اَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهٗ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللّٰهَ يَجِدِ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا) (4. An-Nisa: 110).

(An-Nisa: 110) Jo bura kaam kare ya apni jaan par zulm kar baithe phir Allah se istighfar kare woh Allah ko bakhshne wala aur meherbani karne wala payega. Munafiqon ki saza jo jahannam ke sab se nichle tabqe mein hogi use bayan farma kar bhi farmaya (Illallazina tabu wa aslahu wa bayyanu fa-ula-ika atubu alaihim wa anattauwabur-rahim) (Al-Baqarah: 160) yani un se woh mustasna hain jo tauba karein aur islah kar lein. Mushrikeen Nasara ke is shirk ka ke woh Allah ko teen mein ka teesra maante hain zikr karke un ki sazaon ke bayan se pehle farma diya (Wa-il-lam yantahu amma yaquluna layamassannallazina kafaru minhum azabun aleem) (Al-Ma'idah: 73) ke agar yeh apne qaul se baaz na aaye to. Phir Allah Ta'ala azmat-o-kibriyai jalal-o-shan wale ne farmaya yeh kyun Allah se tauba nahin karte aur kyun us se istighfar nahin karte? Woh to bada hi Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Un logon ka jinhon ne khandaqein khod kar musalmanon ko aag mein dala tha zikr karte hue bhi farmaya hai ke jo musalman mard aurton ko takleef pohancha kar phir bhi tauba na karein un ke liye azab-e-jahannam aur azab-e-naar hai. Imam Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Allah ke karam-o-jood ko dekho ke apne doston ke qatilon ko bhi tauba aur maghfirat ki taraf bula raha hai. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein us shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hai jis ne ninnanve (99) aadmiyon ko qatl kiya tha. Phir Bani Israel ke ek aabid se poocha ke kya us ke liye bhi tauba hai? Us ne inkar kiya us ne use bhi qatl kar diya. Phir ek aalim se poocha us ne jawab diya ke tujh mein aur tauba mein koi rok nahin aur hukm diya ke muwahhidon ki basti mein chala ja chunancha yeh us gaon ki taraf chala lekin raaste mein hi maut aa gayi. Rahmat aur azab ke farishton mein aapas mein ikhtilaf hua. Allah Azzawajal ne zameen ke naapne ka hukm diya to ek balisht bhar nek logon ki basti jis taraf woh hijrat karke ja raha tha qareeb nikli aur yeh unhi ke sath mila diya gaya aur rahmat ke farishte us ki rooh ko le gaye. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke woh maut ke waqt seene ke bal us taraf ghaseetta hua chala tha. Aur yeh bhi warid hua hai ke nek logon ki basti ke qareeb ho jaane ka aur bure logon ki basti ke door ho jaane ka Allah Ta'ala ne hukm diya tha. Yeh hai is hadith ka khulasa, poori hadith apni jagah bayan ho chuki hai.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A is aayat ki tafseer mein farmate hain ke Allah Azzawajal ne tamam bandon ko apni maghfirat ki taraf bulaya hai, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Maseeh A.S ko Allah kehte the, unhein bhi jo Aap ko Allah ka beta kehte the, unhein bhi jo Hazrat Uzair A.S ko Allah ka beta batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah ko faqeer kehte the, unhein bhi jo Allah ke hathon ko band batate the, unhein bhi jo Allah Ta'ala ko teen mein ka teesra kehte the. Allah Ta'ala un sab se farmata hai ke yeh kyun Allah ki taraf nahin jhukte aur kyun us se apne gunahon ki maafi nahin chahte? Allah toh badi bakhshish wala aur bahut hi raham-o-karam wala hai. Phir tauba ki dawat Allah Ta'ala ne use di jis ka qaul un sab se badh chadh kar tha. Jis ne dawa kiya tha ke main tumhara buland-o-bala Rabb hoon. Jo kehta tha ke main nahin jaanta ke tumhara koi mabood mere siwa ho. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke is ke baad bhi jo shakhs Allah ke bandon ko tauba se mayoos kare, woh Allah Azzawajal ki Kitab ka munkir hai. Lekin ise samajh lo ke jab tak Allah kisi bande par apni meherbani se ruju na farmaye use tauba naseeb nahin hoti. Tabrani mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ka qaul hai ke Kitabullah Quran-e-Kareem mein sab se zyada azmat wali aayat Aayat-ul-Kursi hai aur khair-o-sharr ki sab se zyada jame aayat (Innal-laha ya'muru bil-adli wal-ihsani wa eeta'i zil-qurba wa yanha anil-fahsha'i wal-munkari wal-baghi, ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkaroon) (16-An-Nahl: 90) hai aur saare Quran mein sab se zyada khushi ki aayat Surah Zumar ki (Qul ya ibadiyal-lazeena asrafu ala anfusihim la taqnatu mir-rahmatil-lah, innal-laha yaghfiruz-zunuba jamee'a, innahu huwal-ghafoorur-raheem) (39-Az-Zumar: 53) hai aur sab se zyada dharas dene wali aayat (Man yattaqil-laha yaj'al lahu makhraja, wa yarzuqhu min haithu la yahtasib) hai, yani Allah se darte rehne walon ki mukhlisi khud Allah kar deta hai aur use aisi jagah se rozi deta hai jahan ka use khayal-o-guman bhi na ho. Hazrat Masrooq ne yeh sun kar farmaya ke beshak aap sache hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ja rahe the ke aap ne ek waiz ko dekha jo logon ko nasihaten kar raha tha ke aap ne farmaya: Tu kyun logon ko mayoos kar raha hai? Phir isi aayat ki tilawat ki. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) "Un ahadees ka bayan jin mein na-umeedi aur mayoosi ki mumanat hai" Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke us ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karte karte zameen-o-aasman pur kar do phir Allah se istighfar karo toh yaqeenan woh tumhein bakhsh dega. Us ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai, agar tum khatayen karo hi nahin toh Allah Azzawajal tumhein fana kar ke un logon ko laye ga jo khata kar ke istighfar karen aur phir Allah unhein bakhshe. (Musnad Imam Ahmad) Hazrat Abu Ayyub Ansari R.A apne inteqal ke waqt farmate hain.

Ek hadith main ne tum se aaj tak bayan nahin ki thi ab bayan kardeta hoon. Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah hi na karte toh Allah Azza-wa-Jal aisi qoum ko paida karta jo gunah karti phir Allah unhein bakhshta. (Sahih Muslim waghera). Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain gunah ka kaffara nidamat aur sharmsari hai aur aap ne farmaya agar tum gunah na karte toh Allah Ta'ala aise logon ko lata jo gunah karein phir woh unhein bakhshe (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Aap farmate hain Allah Ta'ala us bande ko pasand farmata hai jo kamil yaqeen rakhne wala aur gunahon se tauba karne wala ho (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Abdullah bin Ubaid bin Umair farmate hain ke Iblees maloon ne kaha ae mere Rab tu ne mujhe Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ki wajah se jannat se nikala hai aur main is par is ke baghair ke tu mujhe is par ghalba de ghalib nahin aa sakta. Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya ja tu un par musallat hai. Us ne kaha Allah kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati ata farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja Bani Israel mein jitni aulad paida hogi utni hi tere yahan bhi hogi. Us ne phir iltija ki Bari Ta'ala kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati de. Parwardigar-e-Alam ne farmaya Bani Adam ke seene mein tere liye maskan banadunga aur tum un ke jism mein khoon ki jagah phiro ge us ne phir kaha ke kuch aur bhi mujhe ziyadati inayat farma. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ja tu un par apne sawar aur piyade dora. Aur un ke maal-o-aulad mein apna sajha kar aur unhein umangein dila. Go haqeeqatan tera umangein dilana aur wade karna sarasar dhoke ki tatti hain. Us waqt Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki ke ae mere Parwardigar tu ne ise mujh par musallat kardiya ab main is se tere bachaye baghair bach nahin sakta. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya suno tumhare yahan jo aulad hogi us ke sath main ek muhafiz muqarrar kardunga jo shaitani panje se mehfooz rakhe. Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne aur ziyadati talab ki Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ek neki ko das guna karke dunga balkay das se bhi ziyada. Aur burai usi ke barabar rahegi ya maaf kardunga. Aap ne phir bhi apni yahi dua jaari rakhi. Rabb-ul-Izzat ne farmaya tauba ka darwaza tumhare liye us waqt tak khula hai jab tak rooh jism mein hai, Hazrat Adam (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ne dua ki Allah mujhe aur ziyadati bhi ata farma. Ab Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat parh kar sunayi ke mere gunahgar bandon se keh do woh meri rahmat se mayoos na hon. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A / Razi Allahu Anhu) ki hadith mein hai ke jo log ba-wajah apni kamzori ke kuffar ki takleefein bardasht na karsakne ki wajah se apne deen mein fitne mein par gaye hum us ki nisbat aapas mein kehte the ke Allah Ta'ala un ki koi neki aur tauba qabool na farmaye ga un logon ne Allah ko pehchan kar phir kufr ko le liya aur kafiron ki sakhti ko bardasht na kiya. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aa gaye toh Allah Ta'ala ne un logon ke bare mein hamare is qaul ki tardeed kardi aur (Ya Ibadiyallazina asrafu se La tash'uroon) tak aayatein nazil huin.

Hazrat Umar R.A farmate hain main ne apne haath se in aayaton ko likha aur Hisham bin Aas R.A ke paas bhej diya, Hazrat Hisham farmate hain main us waqt Zi-Tawa mein tha main inhe parh raha tha aur baar baar parhta jata tha aur khoob ghaur-o-khauz kar raha tha lekin asli matlab tak zehan rasai nahin karta tha. Aakhir main ne dua ki ke Parwardigar in aayaton ka sahi matlab aur in ko meri taraf bheje jaane ka sahi maqsad mujh par wazeh karde. Chunancha mere dil mein Allah ki taraf se dala gaya ke in aayaton se murad hum hi hain yeh hamare baare mein hain aur hamein jo khayal tha ke ab hamari tauba qubool nahin ho sakti isi baare mein nazil hui hain. Isi waqt main wapas mura apna oont liya us par sawari ki aur seedha Madine mein aakar Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho gaya. (Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq)

Bandon ki mayusi ko tor kar unhein bakhshish ki umeed dila kar phir hukum diya aur raghbat dilai ke woh tauba aur nek amal ki taraf sabqat aur jaldi karein aisa na ho ke Allah ke azaab aa parein. Jis waqt ke kisi ki madad kuch nahin aati aur unhein chahiye ke azmat wale Quran-e-Kareem ki tabedari aur mat-huti mein mashghool ho jayen is se pehle ke achanak azaab aayen aur yeh be-khabri mein hi hon, us waqt Qayamat ke din be-tauba marne wale aur Allah ki ibadat mein kami lane wale bari hasrat aur bohat afsos karenge aur aarzoo karenge ke kaash ke hum khuloos ke sath ahkaam-e-Allah baja late. Afsos! ke hum to be-yaqeen rahe. Allah ki baton ki tasdeeq hi na ki balkay hansi mazaq hi samajhte rahe aur kahenge ke agar hum bhi hidayat pa lete to yaqeenan Rabb ki nafarmaniyon se duniya mein aur Allah ke azaab se aakhirat mein bach jaate aur azaab ko dekh kar afsos karte hue kahenge ke agar ab dobara duniya ki taraf jana ho jaye to dil khol kar nekiyan kar lein.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke bande kya amal karenge aur kya kuch woh kahenge. Unke amal aur un ke qaul se pehle hi Allah Ta'ala ne is ki khabar de di aur fil-waqay is se zyada ba-khabar kaun ho sakta hai? Na is se zyada sachi khabar koi de sakta hai. Badkaron ke yeh teeno qaul bayan farmaye aur dusri jagah yeh khabar de di ke agar yeh wapas duniya mein bhi bheje jayen to bhi hidayat ko ikhtiyar na karenge. Balkay jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karne lagenge aur yahan jo kehte hain sab jhoot niklega. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai har jahannami ko us ki jannat ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai kaash ke Allah mujhe hidayat deta. Yeh is liye ke use hasrat-o-afsos ho. Aur isi tarah har jannati ko us ki jahannam ki jagah dikhayi jati hai us waqt woh kehta hai ke agar mujhe Allah Ta'ala hidayat na deta to woh jannat mein na aa sakta.

Yeh is liye ke woh shukr aur ehsan ke manne mein aur barh jaye, jab gunahgar log duniya ki taraf lautne ki aarzu karenge aur Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq na karne ki hasrat karenge aur Allah ke rasoolon ko na manne par karhne lagenge to Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga ke ab nidamat la-hasil hai, pachtawa be-sood hai. Duniya mein hi mein to apni aayatein utaar chuka tha, apni daleelein qaim kar chuka tha, lekin tu unhein jhutlata raha aur un ki tabedari se takabbur karta raha, un ka munkir raha. Kufr ikhtiyar kiya, ab kuch nahin ho sakta.

Mushrikeen ke chehre siyah ho jayenge. Qayamat ke din do tarah ke log honge. Kaale munh wale aur noorani chehre wale. Tafraqa aur ikhtilaf walon ke chehre toh siyah pad jayenge aur Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ki khubsurat shaklein noorani ho jayengi. Allah ke shareek thahrane walon, uski aulad muqarrar karne walon ko dekhega ke unke jhoot aur bohtan ki wajah se munh kaale honge. Aur haq ko qabool na karne aur takabbur-o-khudnumai karne ke wabaal mein yeh jahannam mein jhonk diye jayenge. Jahan badi zillat ke sath sakht tar aur badtareen sazayein bhugtenge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki marfoo hadith mein hai ke "Takabbur karne walon ka hashr Qayamat ke din chiyuntiyon ki surat mein hoga, har chhoti se chhoti makhlooq bhi unhein rondti jayegi yahan tak ke jahannam ke jail khane mein band kar diye jayenge jiska naam Bolas hai. Jiski aag bahut tez aur nihayat hi museebat wali hai. Dozakhiyon ko lahu aur peep aur gandagi pilayi jayegi, han Allah ka darr rakhne wale apni kamyabi aur sa'adat mandi ki wajah se is azaab se aur is zillat aur maar peet se bilkul bache hue honge aur koi burai unke paas bhi na phatke gi. Ghabrahat aur gham jo Qayamat ke din aam hoga woh unse alag hoga. Har gham se be-gham aur har darr se be-dar aur har saza aur har dukh se be-parwah honge. Kisi qisam ki daant jhadki unhein na di jayegi, aman-o-aman ke sath rahat-o-chain ke sath Allah ki tamam ne'matein hasil kiye hue honge.

Tamam jaandaar aur be-jaan cheezon ka khaliq, maalik, Rabb aur mutasarrif Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai. Har cheez uski maatahti mein, uske qabze aur uski tadbeer mein hai. Sab ka kaarsaaz aur wakeel wahi hai. Tamam kaamon ki baag-dor usi ke haath mein hai, zameen-o-aasman ki kunjiyon aur unke khazanon ka wahi tanha maalik hai, hamd-o-sataish ke qabil aur har cheez par qadir wahi hai. Kufr-o-inkaar karne wale bade hi ghaate aur nuqsan mein hain. Imam Ibn Abi Hatim (R.H) ne yahan ek hadith waarid ki hai, go sanad ke lihaz se woh bahut hi ghareeb hai, balkeh sehat mein bhi kalaam hai, lekin taham hum bhi ise yahan zikr kar dete hain. Is mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab poocha to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Ae Usman! Tum se pehle kisi ne mujh se is aayat ka matlab daryaft nahin kiya. Is ki tafseer yeh kalmaat hain: (La ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, astaghfirullaha, wa la quwwata illa billah, al-awwalu wal-akhiru waz-zahiru wal-batinu, biyadihil-khairu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer)." Ae Usman! Jo shakhs ise subah ko das baar padh le to Allah Ta'ala use chhe fazail ata farmata hai: Awwal to woh shaitan aur uske lashkar se bach jata hai, dom use ek qintaar ajr milta hai, teesre uska ek darja jannat mein buland hota hai, chauthe uska hoor-e-ain se nikah kara diya jata hai, paanchve uske paas baarah farishte aate hain, chhathe use itna sawab diya jata hai jaise kisi ne Quran aur Taurat aur Injeel-o-Zaboor padhi. Phir is saath hi use ek qabool shuda hajj aur ek maqbool umre ka sawab milta hai aur agar usi din uska inteqal ho jaye to shahadat ka darja milta hai. Yeh hadith bahut ghareeb hai aur is mein badi nakaarat hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain mushrikeen ne aap (ﷺ) se kaha ke aao tum hamare maboodon ki pooja karo aur hum tumhare Rabb ki parastish karenge, is par aayat (Qul afa-ghairallahi... se... minal-khasireen) tak nazil hui. Yehi mazmoon is aayat mein bhi hai: (Wa lau ashraku la-habit 'anhum ma kanu ya'malun) (Surah Al-An'am: 88). Upar Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr hai, phir farmaya hai agar bilfarz yeh Anbiya bhi shirk karein to unke tamam a'maal akaarat aur zaya ho jayen. Yahan bhi farmaya ke teri taraf aur tujh se pehle ke tamam Anbiya ki taraf hum ne yeh wahi bhej di hai ke jo bhi shirk kare us ka amal ghaarat, aur woh nuqsan yafta aur ziyaan-kaar. Pas tujhe chahiye ke tu khuloos ke saath Allah Wahdahu La-Shareeka ki ibadat mein laga reh aur uska shukr-guzaar reh. Tu bhi aur tere manne wale Musalman bhi.

Tamam jaandaar aur be-jaan cheezon ka khaliq, maalik, Rabb aur mutasarrif Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai. Har cheez uski maatahti mein, uske qabze aur uski tadbeer mein hai. Sab ka kaarsaaz aur wakeel wahi hai. Tamam kaamon ki baag-dor usi ke haath mein hai, zameen-o-aasman ki kunjiyon aur unke khazanon ka wahi tanha maalik hai, hamd-o-sataish ke qabil aur har cheez par qadir wahi hai. Kufr-o-inkaar karne wale bade hi ghaate aur nuqsan mein hain. Imam Ibn Abi Hatim (R.H) ne yahan ek hadith waarid ki hai, go sanad ke lihaz se woh bahut hi ghareeb hai, balkeh sehat mein bhi kalaam hai, lekin taham hum bhi ise yahan zikr kar dete hain. Is mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se is aayat ka matlab poocha to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Ae Usman! Tum se pehle kisi ne mujh se is aayat ka matlab daryaft nahin kiya. Is ki tafseer yeh kalmaat hain: (La ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, astaghfirullaha, wa la quwwata illa billah, al-awwalu wal-akhiru waz-zahiru wal-batinu, biyadihil-khairu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer)." Ae Usman! Jo shakhs ise subah ko das baar padh le to Allah Ta'ala use chhe fazail ata farmata hai: Awwal to woh shaitan aur uske lashkar se bach jata hai, dom use ek qintaar ajr milta hai, teesre uska ek darja jannat mein buland hota hai, chauthe uska hoor-e-ain se nikah kara diya jata hai, paanchve uske paas baarah farishte aate hain, chhathe use itna sawab diya jata hai jaise kisi ne Quran aur Taurat aur Injeel-o-Zaboor padhi. Phir is saath hi use ek qabool shuda hajj aur ek maqbool umre ka sawab milta hai aur agar usi din uska inteqal ho jaye to shahadat ka darja milta hai. Yeh hadith bahut ghareeb hai aur is mein badi nakaarat hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain mushrikeen ne aap (ﷺ) se kaha ke aao tum hamare maboodon ki pooja karo aur hum tumhare Rabb ki parastish karenge, is par aayat (Qul afa-ghairallahi... se... minal-khasireen) tak nazil hui. Zameen-o-Aasman Allah ki ungliyon mein. Mushrikeen ne darasal Allah Ta'ala ki qadr-o-azmat jaani hi nahin isi wajah se woh us ke saath dusron ko shareek karne lage, us se barh kar izzat wala us se zyada badshahat wala us se barh kar ghalbe aur qudrat wala koi nahin, na koi us ka hamsar aur karne wala hai. Yeh aayat kuffar-e-Quraish ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Unhein agar qadr hoti toh us ki baaton ko ghalat na jaante. Jo shakhs Allah ko har cheez par qadir maane, woh hai jis ne Allah ki azmat ki aur jis ka yeh aqeeda na ho woh Allah ki qadr karne wala nahin. Is aayat ke mutaliq bahut si hadeesein aayi hain. Is jaisi aayaton ke bare mein Salaf-e-Saliheen ka maslak yahi raha hai ke jis tarah aur jin lafzon mein yeh aayi hai isi tarah unhi lafzon ke saath unhein maan lena aur un par imaan rakhna. Na un ki kaifiyat tatolna na un mein tahreef-o-tabdeeli karna, Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein is aayat ki tafseer mein hai ke Yahudiyon ka ek bara aalim Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur kehne laga ke hum yeh likha paate hain ke Allah Azzawajal saaton aasmanon ko ek ungli par rakh le ga aur sab zameenon ko ek ungli par rakh le ga aur darakhton ko ek ungli par rakh le ga aur paani aur mitti ko ek ungli par aur baqi tamam makhlooq ko ek ungli par rakh le ga phir farmaye ga main hi sab ka maalik aur saccha badshah hoon. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us ki baat ki sacchai par hans diye yahan tak ke aap ke masoorhay zahir ho gaye. Phir aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Musnad ki hadees bhi isi ke qareeb hai us mein hai ke aap hanse aur Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari aur riwayat mein hai ke woh apni ungliyon par batata jata tha pehle us ne kalme ki ungli dikhayi thi. Is riwayat mein chaar ungliyon ka zikr hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein hai Allah Ta'ala zameen ko qabz kar le ga aur aasman ko apni dahni mutthi mein le le ga. Phir farmaye ga main hoon badshah kahan hain zameen ke badshah? Muslim ki is hadees mein hai ke zameenein us ki ek ungli par hongi aur aasman us ke dahne haath mein honge phir farmaye ga main hi badshah hoon. Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek din mimbar par is aayat ki tilawat ki aur aap apna haath hilate jaate aage peeche la rahe thay aur farmate thay Allah Ta'ala apni buzurgi aap bayan farmaye ga ke main Jabbar hoon main Mutakabbir hoon main Maalik hoon main ba-izzat hoon main Kareem hoon. Aap us ke bayan ke waqt itna hil rahe thay ke hamein dar lagne laga ke kahin aap mimbar samet gir na parein. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne is ki poori kaifiyat dikha di ke kis tarah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise hikayat kiya tha? Ke Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aasmanon aur zameenon ko apne haath mein le ga aur farmaye ga main badshah hoon. Apni ungliyon ko kabhi khole ga kabhi band kare ga aur aap us waqt hil rahe thay yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke hilne se sara mimbar hilne laga aur mujhe dar laga ke kahin woh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko gira na de. Bazzar ki riwayat mein hai ke aap ne yeh aayat parhi aur mimbar hilne laga pas aap teen martaba aaye gaye Wallahu A'lam.

Mu'jam-e-Kabeer Tabrani ki ek ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Sahaba ki ek jama'at se farmaya main aaj tumhein Surah Zumar ki aakhri aayatein sunaunga jise un se rona aa gaya woh jannati ho gaya. Ab aap ne is aayat se lekar khatm-e-Surah tak ki aayatein tilawat farmayin. Ba'az roye aur ba'az ko rona na aaya, unhon ne arz kiya Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum ne har chand rona chaha lekin rona na aaya. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya achha main phir parhunga jise rona na aaye woh roni shakal banakar ba-takalluf roye. Ek is se barh kar ghareeb hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main ne teen cheezein apne bandon mein chupa li hain agar woh unhein dekh lete toh koi shakhs kabhi koi bad-amali na karta. 001 Agar main parda hata deta aur woh mujhe dekh kar khoob yaqeen kar lete aur maloom kar lete ke main apni makhlooq ke sath kya kuch karta hoon jabke un ke paas aaun aur aasmanon ko apni mutthi mein le loon phir apni zameen ko apni mutthi mein le loon phir kahun main badshah hoon mere siwa mulk ka maalik kaun hai? 002 Phir main unhein jannat dikhaun aur is mein jo bhalaiyan hain sab un ke samne kar doon aur woh yaqeen ke sath khoob achi tarah dekh lein. 003 Aur main unhein jahannam dikha doon aur is ke azaab dikha doon yahan tak ke unhein yaqeen aa jaye. Lekin main ne yeh cheezein qasdan un se posheeda kar rakhi hain. Taake main jaan loon ke woh mujhe kis tarah jaante hain kyunke main ne yeh sab baatein bayan kar di hain. Is ki sanad mutaqarib hai aur is nuskhe se bahut si hadeesein riwayat ki jaati hain. Wallahu A'lam.

Qayamat ki holnaki ka bayan. Qayamat ki holnaki aur dehshat-o-wahshat ka zikr ho raha hai ke soor phoonka jaye ga. Yeh doosra soor hoga jis se har zinda murda ho jaye ga khwah aasman mein ho khwah zameen mein. Magar jise Allah chahey. Soor ki mashhoor hadith mein hai ke phir baqi walon ki roohein qabz ki jayengi yahan tak ke sab se aakhir khud Malak-ul-Maut ki rooh bhi qabz ki jaye gi aur sirf Allah Ta'ala hi baqi reh jaye ga jo Hayy-o-Qayyum hai jo awwal se tha aur aakhir mein dawam ke sath reh jaye ga. Phir farmaye ga ke aaj kis ka raaj paat hai? Teen martaba yehi farmaye ga phir khud aap hi apne aap ko jawab de ga ke Allah Wahid-o-Qahhar ka, main hi akela hoon jis ne har cheez ko apni mat-huti mein kar rakha hai aaj main ne sab ko fana ka hukum de diya hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq ko dobara zinda kare ga. Sab se pehle Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko zinda kare ga aur unhein hukum de ga ke dobara nafkha phoonkein yeh teesra soor hoga jis se sari makhlooq jo murda thi zinda ho jaye gi jis ka bayan is aayat mein hai ke aur nafkha phoonka jaye ga aur sab log uth kharay honge aur nazrein doranay lagenge. Yani Qayamat ki dil-doz halat dekhne lagenge, jaise farman hai (فَاِنَّمَا ھِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَّاحِدَةٌ 13؀ۙ) (79. An-Nazi'at: 13) yani woh to sirf ek hi sakht aawaz hogi jis se sab log foran hi ek maidan mein aa mojood honge. Aur aayat mein hai (يَوْمَ يَدْعُوْكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيْبُوْنَ بِحَمْدِهٖ وَتَظُنُّوْنَ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا 52؀) (17. Al-Isra: 52), yani jis din Allah Ta'ala unhein bulaye ga to sab us ki hamd karte hue us ki pukaar ko maan lo ge aur duniya ki zindagi ko kam samajhne lago ge. Allah Jalla-o-Ala ka aur jagah irshad hai (وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ تَــقُوْمَ السَّمَاۗءُ وَالْاَرْضُ بِاَمْرِهٖ ۭ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً ڰ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ ڰ اِذَآ اَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُوْنَ 25؀) (30. Ar-Rum: 25) us ki nishaniyon mein se zameen aasman ka us ke hukum se qaim rehna hai phir jab woh tumhein zameen mein se pukaar kar bulaye ga to tum sab yakbargi nikal paro ge. Musnad-e-Ahmad hai ke ek shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) se kaha ke aap farmate hain itne itne waqt tak Qayamat aa jaye gi. Aap ne naraz ho kar farmaya jee to chahta hai ke tum se koi baat bayan hi na karoon. Main ne to kaha tha ke bohat thori muddat mein tum ahem amr dekho ge phir farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai meri ummat mein Dajjal aaye ga aur woh chalees saal tak rahe ga main nahin jaanta ke chalees din ya chalees mahine ya chalees saal ya chalees raatein phir Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Isa bin Maryam (Alaihis Salam) ko bheje ga. Woh bilkul surat-e-shakal mein Hazrat Urwah bin Mas'ood Saqafi jaise honge Allah aap ko ghalib kare ga aur Dajjal aap ke hathon halak hoga phir saat saal tak log is tarah milay julay rahenge ke sari duniya mein do shakhson ke darmiyan bhi aapas mein ranjish-o-adawat na hogi.

Phir Parwardigar-e-Alam Sham ki taraf ek halki thandi hawa chalaye ga. Jis se tamam iman walon ki rooh qabz kar li jaye gi yahan tak ke jis ke dil mein rai ke danay ke barabar iman hoga woh bhi khatam ho jaye ga. Yeh khwah kahin bhi ho. Yahan tak ke agar kisi pahari ki khoh mein bhi koi Musalman hoga toh yeh hawa wahan bhi pahunch jaye gi. Main ne ise Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai. Phir toh badtareen log baqi reh jayenge jo apne kamina-pan mein misl parindon ke halkay aur apni bewaqoofi mein misl darindon ke bewaqoof honge, na achhai ko achhai samjhenge na burai ko burai janenge. Is ke ilawa woh behre, goonge aur andhe honge aur munh ke bal ghaseet kar laye jayenge, yeh andhe, goonge aur behre honge, un ka thikana dozakh hoga, jab is ki aatish dheemi hone lagegi hum ise aur tez kar denge. Yeh qareeb pahunchenge darwaze khul jayenge taake foran hi azab-e-nar shuru ho jaye. Phir unhein wahan ke muhafiz farishte sharminda karne ke liye aur nadamat barhane ke liye daant kar aur jhirak kar kahenge, kyunke un mein raham ka to madda hi nahin, sarasar sakhti karne wale, sakht gusse wale aur bari buri tarah maar maarne wale hain, ke kya tumhare paas tumhari hi jins ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) nahin aaye the? Jin se tum sawal jawab kar sakte the, apna itminan aur tasalli kar sakte the, un ki baton ko samajh sakte the, un ki sohbat mein baith sakte the. Unhon ne Allah ki aayatein tumhein parh kar sunayin, apne laye hue sache deen par daleelein qaim kar dein. Tumhein is din ki buraiyon se aagah kar diya. Aaj ke azabon se daraya. Kafir iqrar karenge ke haan yeh sach hai, beshak Allah ke paighambar hum mein aaye. Unhon ne daleelein bhi qaim keen, humein bahut kuch kaha suna bhi. Daraya dhamkaya bhi. Lekin hum ne un ki ek na mani, balkay un ke khilaf kiya muqabla kiya kyunke hamari qismat mein hi shaqawat thi. Azali bad-naseeb hum the. Haq se hat gaye aur batil ke tarafdar ban gaye. Jaise Surah Tabarak ki aayat mein hai, jab jahannam mein koi giroh dala jayega. Us se wahan ke muhafiz poochenge ke kya tumhare paas koi darane wala nahin aaya tha? Woh jawab denge ke haan aaya to tha lekin hum ne us ki takzeeb ki aur keh diya ke Allah Ta'ala ne kuch bhi nazil nahin farmaya, tum bari bhari ghalti mein ho. Agar hum sunte ya samajhte to aaj dozakhiyon mein na hote. Yani apne aap ko aap malamat karne lagenge, apne gunah ka khud iqrar karenge. Allah farmayega doori aur khasara ho. La'nat-o-phutkar ho ahl-e-dozakh par, kaha jayega yani har woh shakhs jo unhein dekhega aur un ki halat ko maloom karega woh saaf keh uthega ke beshak yeh isi laiq hain. Isi liye kehne wale ka naam nahin liya gaya balkay use mutlaq chhora gaya taake us ka umoom baqi rahe. Aur Allah Ta'ala ke adl ki gawahi kamil ho jaye. Un se keh diya jayega ke ab jao jahannam mein, yahin hamesha jalte bhulaste rehna, na yahan se kisi tarah kisi waqt chhutkara mile, na tumhein maut aaye. Aah! Yeh kya hi bura thikana hai jis mein din raat jalna hi jalna hai. Yeh hai tumhare takabbur ka aur haq ko na manne ka badla. Jis ne tumhein aisi buri jagah pahunchaya aur yahin kar diya.

Kuffar ki aakhri manzil. Bad-naseeb munkireen-e-haq, kuffar ka anjam bayan ho raha hai ke woh janwaron ki tarah ruswai, zillat, daant-dapat aur jhirki se jahannam ki taraf hankaye jayenge. Jaise aur aayat mein 'yud'auna' ka lafz hai yani dhakke diye jayenge aur sakht pyase honge, jaise Allah Jalla wa 'Ala ne farmaya (Yauma nahshurul muttaqeena) ilakh, jis roz hum parhezgaron ko Rahman ke mehman banakar jama karenge aur gunahgaron ko dozakh ki taraf pyasa hanken ge. Is ke ilawa woh behre, goonge aur andhe honge aur munh ke bal ghaseet kar laye jayenge, yeh andhe, goonge aur behre honge, un ka thikana dozakh hoga, jab is ki aatish dheemi hone lagegi hum ise aur tez kar denge. Un se keh diya jayega ke ab jao jahannam mein, yahin hamesha jalte bhulaste rehna, na yahan se kisi tarah kisi waqt chhutkara mile, na tumhein maut aaye. Aah!
