Muttaqiyon ki aakhri manzil. Upar badbakhton ka anjam aur un ka haal bayan hua, yahan sa'adat mandon ka natija bayan ho raha hai ke yeh behtareen khubsurat untniyon par sawar ho kar jannat ki taraf pahunchaye jayenge. In ki bhi jamatein hongi, muqarrabeen-e-khas ki jamaat, phir barabar ki, phir un se kam darje walon ki, phir un se kam darje walon ki, har jamaat apne munasib logon ke sath hogi, ambiya ambiya ke hamrah, siddiq apne jaison ke sath, shaheed log apne walon ke hamrah, ulama apne jaison ke sath, garz har ham-jins apne mel ke logon ke sath honge. Jab woh jannat ke paas pahunchenge, pul-e-sirat se paar ho chuke honge, wahan ek pul par thahraye jayenge aur un mein aapas mein jo mazalim honge un ka qisas aur badla ho jayega. Jab paak saaf ho jayenge to jannat mein jaane ki ijazat payenge.

Soor ki mutawwal hadith mein hai ke jannat ke darwazon par pahunch kar yeh aapas mein mashwara karenge ke dekho sab se pehle kise ijazat di jati hai, phir woh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qasd karenge, phir Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) wa alaihimus salam ka. Jaise maidan-e-mahshar mein shafa'at ke mauqa par bhi kiya tha. Is se bada maqsad Janab-e-Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ki fazeelat ka mauqa ba-mauqa izhar karna hai. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai, "Main jannat mein pehla safarshi hoon." Ek aur riwayat mein hai, "Main pehla woh shakhs hoon jo jannat ka darwaza khatkhatayega." Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, "Main qayamat ke din jannat ka darwaza khulwana chahunga to wahan ka darwaza mujh se puchega ke aap kaun hain? Main kahunga ke Muhammad (ﷺ), woh kahega mujhe yahi hukm tha ke aap ki tashreef aawari se pehle jannat ka darwaza kisi ke liye na khulun."

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke pehli jamaat jo jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise honge, thook, rent, peshab, pakhana wahan kuch na hoga, un ke bartan aur saman-e-araish sone chandi ka hoga. Un ki angithiyon mein behtareen agar khushbu de raha hoga, un ka paseena mushk hoga. Un mein se har ek ki do biwiyan hongi jin ki pindli ka guda ba-wajah-e-husn-o-nazakat, safai aur nafasat ke gosht ke peeche se nazar aa raha hoga. Kisi do mein koi ikhtilaf aur hasad-o-bugz na hoga. Sab ghul mil kar aise honge jaise ek shakhs ka dil. Jo jannat mein jayega un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge. Un ke baad wali jamaat ke chehre aise honge jaise behtareen chamakta sitara, phir qareeb qareeb upar wali hadith ke bayan hai aur yeh bhi hai ke un ke qad saath haath ke honge, jaise Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qad tha. Aur hadith mein hai ke meri ummat ki ek jamaat jo sattar hazar ki tadaad mein hogi pehle pahal jannat mein dakhil hogi, un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand ki tarah chamak rahe honge.

Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha bin Mihsan (R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe bhi inhi mein se karde. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki ke Allah inhe bhi inhi mein se karde, phir ek Ansari ne bhi yahi arz ki, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat le gaya. In sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein dakhil hona bahut si kitabon mein bahut si sanadon se bahut se sahaba se marwi hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke sab ek sath hi jannat mein qadam rakhenge, unke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise honge. Ibn Abi Shaiba mein hai mujhse mere Rabb ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge, unse na hisab hoga na unhein azab hoga. Inke alawa aur teen lappein bhar kar, jo Allah Ta'ala apne hathon se lapp bhar kar jannat mein pahunchayega. Tabrani. Is riwayat mein hai phir har hazar ke sath sattar hazar honge. Is hadith ke bahut se shawahid hain. Jab yeh sa'eed bakht buzurg jannat ke paas pahunch jayenge, inke liye darwaze khul jayenge, unki wahan izzat-o-ta'zeem hogi, wahan ke muhafiz farishte unhein basharat sunayenge, unki tareefein karenge, unhein salam karenge. Iske baad ka jawab Quran mein mahzoof rakha gaya hai taake umoomiyat baqi rahe, matlab yeh hai ke us waqt yeh poore khush-waqt ho jayenge, be-andaz suroor, rahat, aaram-o-chain unhein milega. Har tarah ki aas aur bhalai ki umeed bandh jayegi. Haan yahan yeh bayan kar dena bhi zaroori hai ke ba'az logon ne jo kaha hai ke wa-futihat mein waw aathwein hai aur is se istidlal kiya hai ke jannat ke aath darwaze hain, unhone bada takalluf kiya hai aur bekar mushaqqat uthayi hai. Jannat ke aath darwazon ka suboot to sahih ahadith mein saaf maujood hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs apne maal mein se Allah ki rah mein kharch karle woh jannat ke sab darwazon se bulaya jayega. Jannat ke kayi ek darwaze hain, namazi Bab-us-Salah se, sakhi Bab-us-Sadaqah se, mujahid Bab-ul-Jihad se, rozedar Bab-ur-Rayyan se bulaye jayenge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) go iski zaroorat to nahin ke har darwaze se pukara jaye, jis se bhi pukara jaye maqsad to jannat mein jane se hai, lekin kya koi aisa bhi hai jo jannat ke kul darwazon se bulaya jaye? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan aur mujhe umeed hai ke tum inhi mein se hoge. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim waghera mein bhi hai. Bukhari Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai jannat mein aath darwaze hain. Jin mein se ek ka naam Bab-ur-Rayyan hai, us mein se sirf rozedar hi dakhil honge. Sahih Muslim mein hai tum mein se jo shakhs kamil mukammal bahut achi tarah mal mal kar wuzu kare phir Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu padhe, uske liye jannat ke aathon darwaze khul jate hain, jis se chahe chala jaye. Aur hadith mein hai jannat ki kunji La ilaha illallah hai. "Jannat ke darwazon ki kushadgi ka bayan" Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare.

Shafa'at ki mutawwal hadith mein hai ke phir Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad (ﷺ)! Apni ummat mein se jin par hisab nahin, unhein dahni taraf ke darwaze se jannat mein le jao, lekin aur darwazon mein bhi yeh dusron ke sath shareek hain." Us zaat ki qasam jiske hath mein Muhammad (ﷺ) ki jaan hai, ke jannat ki chaukhat itni badi wus'at wali hai jitna fasla Makkah aur Hajar mein hai, ya farmaya Hajar aur Makkah mein hai. Ek riwayat mein hai Makkah aur Basra mein hai. (Bukhari o Muslim). Hazrat Utbah bin Ghazwan (R.A) ne apne khutbe mein bayan farmaya ke hum se yeh zikr kiya gaya hai ke jannat ke darwaze ki wus'at chalees saal ki raah hai. Ek aisa din bhi aane wala hai jab ke jannat mein jaane walon ki bheed-bhaad se yeh wasee darwaze khacha-khach bhare hue honge. (Muslim). Musnad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain, "Jannat ki chaukhat chalees saal ki raah ki hai." Yeh jab jannat ke paas pahunchenge, unhein farishtay salam karenge aur mubarakbad denge ke tumhare a'maal, tumhare aqwal, tumhari koshish aur tumhara badla har cheez khushi wali aur umdagi wali hai. Jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kisi ghazway ke mauqay par apne munadi se farmaya tha, "Jao nida kardo ke jannat mein sirf musalman log hi jayenge," ya farmaya tha, "Sirf momin hi." Farishtay un se kahenge ke tum ab yahan se nikale na jaoge, balkay yahan tumhare liye dawam hai. Apna yeh haal dekh kar khush ho kar jannati Allah ka shukr ada karenge aur kahenge ke Alhamdulillah, jo wada hum se Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasoolon ki zabani kiya tha, use pura kiya. Yehi dua unki duniya mein thi: (RABBANA WA ATINA MA WA'ADTANA 'ALA RUSULIKA WA LA TUKHZINA YAWMAL QIYAMATI INNAKA LA TUKHLIFUL MI'AD) (Surah Al-Imran: 194). Yani, "Aye hamare Parwardigar! Hamein woh de jiska wada tu ne apne Rasoolon ki zabani hum se kiya hai aur hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, yaqeenan teri zaat wada khilafi se paak hai." Aur aayat mein hai ke is mauqay par Ahl-e-Jannat yeh bhi kahenge, "Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hamein is ki hidayat ki, agar woh hidayat na karta to hum hidayat na pa sakte. Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool hamare paas haq laye thay." Woh yeh bhi kahenge ke Allah hi ke liye sab tareef hai jis ne hum se gham door kar diya, yaqeenan hamara Rab bakhshne wala aur qadr karne wala hai. Jis ne apne fazl o karam se yeh paak jagah hamein naseeb farmayi, jahan hamein na koi dukh dard hai na ranj o takleef. Yahan hai ke yeh kahenge is se hamein jannat ki zameen ka waris kiya. Jaise farman hai (WALAQAD KATABNA FI ZABOOR) al-kh, hum ne Zaboor mein zikr ke baad likh diya tha ke zameen ke waris mere nek banday honge. Isi tarah aaj jannati kahenge ke is jannat mein hum jahan jagah bana lein koi rok tok nahin. Yeh hai behtareen badla hamare a'maal ka. Me'raj wale waqiye mein Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke jannat ke dere khemay lulu ke hain aur uski mitti musk-e-khalis hai. Ibn-e-Sa'id se jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jannat ki mitti ka sawal kiya to us ne kaha, "Safed maiday jaisi musk-e-khalis."

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh sacha hai (Muslim). Muslim hi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn-e-Sa'id ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha tha. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul marwi hai ke Jannat ke darwaze par pahunch kar yeh ek darakht ko dekhenge jis ki jar mein se do nahrein nikalti hongi. Ek mein woh ghusl karenge jis se is qadar paak saaf ho jayenge ke un ke jism aur chehre chamakne lagenge. Un ke baal kanghi kiye hue tel wale ho jayenge ke phir kabhi suljhane ki zaroorat hi na pade na chehre aur jism ka rang roop halka pade. Phir yeh dusri nehar par jayenge goya ke un se keh diya gaya ho is mein se paani piyenge jin se tamam ghan ki cheezon se paak ho jayenge. Jannat ke farishte unhein salam karenge mubarakbad pesh karenge aur unhein Jannat mein le jaane ke liye kahenge. Har ek ke paas us ke ghilman aayenge aur khushi khushi un par qurban honge aur kahenge aap khush ho jaiye Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke liye tarah tarah ki ne'matein muhayya kar rakhi hain. Un mein se kuch bhage daude jayenge aur jo hoorein us jannati ke liye makhsoos hain un se kahenge lo mubarak ho falan sahab aa gaye. Naam sunte hi khush ho kar woh poochengi ke kya tum ne khud unhein dekha hai? Woh kahenge haan hum apni aankhon se dekh kar aa rahe hain. Yeh maare khushi ke darwaze par aa khadi hongi. Jannati jab apne mahal mein aayega to dekhega ke gadde barabar barabar lage hue hain aur aab-khoray rakhe hue hain aur qaleen biche hue hain. Is farsh ko mulahiza farma kar ab jo deewaron ki taraf nazar karega to woh surkh-o-sabz aur zard-o-safaid aur qisam qisam ke motiyon ki bani hui hongi. Phir chhat ki taraf nigah uthayega to woh is qadar shaffaf aur musaffa hogi ke noor ki tarah chamak damak rahi hogi. Agar Allah ise barqarar na rakhe to is ki roshni aankhon ki roshni ko bujha de. Phir apni biwiyon par yani jannati hooron par mohabbat bhari nigah daalega. Phir apne takhton mein se jis par us ka jee chahe baithega. Aur kahega Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hamein is ki hidayat ki agar Allah hamein yeh raah na dikhata to hum to hargiz ise talash nahin kar sakte the. Aur hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai jab yeh apni qabron se niklenge. Un ka istiqbal kiya jayega un ke liye paron wali oontniyan layi jayengi jin par sone ke kajaway honge un ki jotiyon ke tasmay tak noor se chamak rahe honge. Yeh oontniyan ek ek qadam is qadar door rakhti hain jahan tak insaan ki nigah ja sakti hai. Yeh ek darakht ke paas pahunchengi jis ke neeche se nahrein nikalti hain. Ek ka paani yeh piyenge jis se un ke pet ki tamam fazooliyat aur mail kuchail dhul jayega dusri nehar se yeh ghusl karenge phir hamesha tak un ke badan mailay na honge un ke baal paraganda na honge aur un ke jism aur chehre baronaq rahenge. Ab yeh Jannat ke darwazon par aayenge dekhenge ke ek kunda surkh yaqoot ka hai jo sone ki takhti par aawizan hai.

Yeh isay hilayenge toh ek ajeeb sureeli aur mauseeqi sada paida hogi, isay suntay hi hoor jaan legi ke uskay khawand aa gaye. Yeh daroghay ko hukum dengi ke jao darwaza kholo, woh darwaza khol dega. Yeh andar qadam rakhtay hi us daroghay ki noorani shakal dekh kar sajday mein gir paray ga lekin woh isay rok lega aur kahay ga apna sar utha, main toh tera matahat hoon. Aur isay apnay sath le chalay ga. Jab yeh us dur-o-yaqoot ke khaimay ke paas pohanchay ga jahan uski hoor hai, woh betabana dor kar khaimay se bahar aa jaye gi aur baghal-geer ho kar kahay gi: Tum meray mehboob ho aur main tumhari chahnay wali hoon, main yahan hamesha rehnay wali hoon, marungi nahin. Main naimaton wali hoon, faqr-o-mohtaji se door hoon. Main aap se hamesha raazi khushi rahungi, kabhi naraz nahin hungi. Main hamesha aap ki khidmat mein hazir rehnay wali hoon, kabhi idhar udhar nahin hatungi. Phir yeh ghar mein jaye ga jis ki chhat farsh se ek laakh haath buland hogi. Is ki kul deewarein qisam qisam ke aur rang-barangay motiyon ki hongi. Is ghar mein sattar takht honge aur har takht par sattar sattar chholdariyan hongi aur un mein se har bistar par sattar hoorein hongi, har hoor par sattar joray honge aur un sab hullon ke neechay se un ki pindli ka gooda nazar aata hoga. Un ke ek jama' ka andaza ek poori raat ka hoga. Un ke baghon aur makanon ke neechay nehrein beh rahi hongi. Jin ka pani kabhi badboodar nahin hota, saaf shaffaf moti jaisa pani hai aur doodh ki nehrein hongi jin ka maza kabhi nahin badalta, jo doodh kisi janwar ke than se nahin nikla. Aur sharab ki nehrein hongi jo nihayat lazeez hongi jo kisi insani hathon ka banaya hua nahin. Aur khalis shehad ki nehrein hongi jo makkhiyon ke pait se hasil shuda nahin. Qisam qisam ke mewon se laday huay darakht uskay charon taraf honge jin ka phal un ki taraf jhuka hua hoga. Yeh kharay kharay phal lena chahein toh le saktay hain, agar yeh baithay baithay phal torna chahein toh shakhain itni jhuk jayengi ke yeh tor lein, agar yeh laitay laitay phal lena chahein toh shakhain itni jhuk jayengi. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّـلَتْ قُـطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا 14؀) (Surah Al-Insan: 14) parhi, yani un jannati darakhton ke saaye un par jhukay huay honge aur un ke meway bohat qareeb kar diye jayenge. Yeh khana khanay ki khwahish karenge toh safaid rang ya sabz rang parinday un ke paas aa kar apna par ooncha kar denge, yeh jis qisam ka uskay pehlu ka gosht chahein khayenge, phir woh zinda ka zinda jaisa tha waisa hi ho kar ur jaye ga. Farishtay un ke paas aayenge, salam karenge aur kahenge ke yeh jannatein hain jin ke tum apnay aamaal ke baais waris banaye gaye ho. Agar kisi hoor ka ek baal zameen par aa jaye toh woh apni chamak se aur apni siyahi se noor ko roshan karay aur siyahi numaya karay. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai go ke yeh mursal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Muttaqiyon ki aakhri manzil. Upar badbakhton ka anjam aur un ka haal bayan hua, yahan sa'adat mandon ka natija bayan ho raha hai ke yeh behtareen khubsurat untniyon par sawar ho kar jannat ki taraf pahunchaye jayenge. In ki bhi jamatein hongi, muqarrabeen-e-khas ki jamaat, phir barabar ki, phir un se kam darje walon ki, phir un se kam darje walon ki, har jamaat apne munasib logon ke sath hogi, ambiya ambiya ke hamrah, siddiq apne jaison ke sath, shaheed log apne walon ke hamrah, ulama apne jaison ke sath, garz har ham-jins apne mel ke logon ke sath honge. Jab woh jannat ke paas pahunchenge, pul-e-sirat se paar ho chuke honge, wahan ek pul par thahraye jayenge aur un mein aapas mein jo mazalim honge un ka qisas aur badla ho jayega. Jab paak saaf ho jayenge to jannat mein jaane ki ijazat payenge.

Soor ki mutawwal hadith mein hai ke jannat ke darwazon par pahunch kar yeh aapas mein mashwara karenge ke dekho sab se pehle kise ijazat di jati hai, phir woh Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qasd karenge, phir Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Isa (A.S) ka, phir Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) wa alaihimus salam ka. Jaise maidan-e-mahshar mein shafa'at ke mauqa par bhi kiya tha. Is se bada maqsad Janab-e-Ahmad-e-Mujtaba Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) ki fazeelat ka mauqa ba-mauqa izhar karna hai. Sahih Muslim ki hadith mein hai, "Main jannat mein pehla safarshi hoon." Ek aur riwayat mein hai, "Main pehla woh shakhs hoon jo jannat ka darwaza khatkhatayega." Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, "Main qayamat ke din jannat ka darwaza khulwana chahunga to wahan ka darwaza mujh se puchega ke aap kaun hain? Main kahunga ke Muhammad (ﷺ), woh kahega mujhe yahi hukm tha ke aap ki tashreef aawari se pehle jannat ka darwaza kisi ke liye na khulun."

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke pehli jamaat jo jannat mein jayegi un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise honge, thook, rent, peshab, pakhana wahan kuch na hoga, un ke bartan aur saman-e-araish sone chandi ka hoga. Un ki angithiyon mein behtareen agar khushbu de raha hoga, un ka paseena mushk hoga. Un mein se har ek ki do biwiyan hongi jin ki pindli ka guda ba-wajah-e-husn-o-nazakat, safai aur nafasat ke gosht ke peeche se nazar aa raha hoga. Kisi do mein koi ikhtilaf aur hasad-o-bugz na hoga. Sab ghul mil kar aise honge jaise ek shakhs ka dil. Jo jannat mein jayega un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand ki tarah roshan honge. Un ke baad wali jamaat ke chehre aise honge jaise behtareen chamakta sitara, phir qareeb qareeb upar wali hadith ke bayan hai aur yeh bhi hai ke un ke qad saath haath ke honge, jaise Hazrat Adam (A.S) ka qad tha. Aur hadith mein hai ke meri ummat ki ek jamaat jo sattar hazar ki tadaad mein hogi pehle pahal jannat mein dakhil hogi, un ke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand ki tarah chamak rahe honge.

Yeh sun kar Hazrat Ukasha bin Mihsan (R.A) ne darkhwast ki ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala se dua kijiye ke Allah mujhe bhi inhi mein se karde. Aap (ﷺ) ne dua ki ke Allah inhe bhi inhi mein se karde, phir ek Ansari ne bhi yahi arz ki, Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Ukasha tujh par sabqat le gaya. In sattar hazar ka be-hisab jannat mein dakhil hona bahut si kitabon mein bahut si sanadon se bahut se sahaba se marwi hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke sab ek sath hi jannat mein qadam rakhenge, unke chehre chaudhwin raat ke chand jaise honge. Ibn Abi Shaiba mein hai mujhse mere Rabb ka wada hai ke meri ummat mein se sattar hazar shakhs jannat mein jayenge, har hazar ke sath sattar hazar aur honge, unse na hisab hoga na unhein azab hoga. Inke alawa aur teen lappein bhar kar, jo Allah Ta'ala apne hathon se lapp bhar kar jannat mein pahunchayega. Tabrani. Is riwayat mein hai phir har hazar ke sath sattar hazar honge. Is hadith ke bahut se shawahid hain. Jab yeh sa'eed bakht buzurg jannat ke paas pahunch jayenge, inke liye darwaze khul jayenge, unki wahan izzat-o-ta'zeem hogi, wahan ke muhafiz farishte unhein basharat sunayenge, unki tareefein karenge, unhein salam karenge. Iske baad ka jawab Quran mein mahzoof rakha gaya hai taake umoomiyat baqi rahe, matlab yeh hai ke us waqt yeh poore khush-waqt ho jayenge, be-andaz suroor, rahat, aaram-o-chain unhein milega. Har tarah ki aas aur bhalai ki umeed bandh jayegi. Haan yahan yeh bayan kar dena bhi zaroori hai ke ba'az logon ne jo kaha hai ke wa-futihat mein waw aathwein hai aur is se istidlal kiya hai ke jannat ke aath darwaze hain, unhone bada takalluf kiya hai aur bekar mushaqqat uthayi hai. Jannat ke aath darwazon ka suboot to sahih ahadith mein saaf maujood hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs apne maal mein se Allah ki rah mein kharch karle woh jannat ke sab darwazon se bulaya jayega. Jannat ke kayi ek darwaze hain, namazi Bab-us-Salah se, sakhi Bab-us-Sadaqah se, mujahid Bab-ul-Jihad se, rozedar Bab-ur-Rayyan se bulaye jayenge. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) go iski zaroorat to nahin ke har darwaze se pukara jaye, jis se bhi pukara jaye maqsad to jannat mein jane se hai, lekin kya koi aisa bhi hai jo jannat ke kul darwazon se bulaya jaye? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan aur mujhe umeed hai ke tum inhi mein se hoge. Yeh hadith Bukhari Muslim waghera mein bhi hai. Bukhari Muslim ki ek aur hadith mein hai jannat mein aath darwaze hain. Jin mein se ek ka naam Bab-ur-Rayyan hai, us mein se sirf rozedar hi dakhil honge. Sahih Muslim mein hai tum mein se jo shakhs kamil mukammal bahut achi tarah mal mal kar wuzu kare phir Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasooluhu padhe, uske liye jannat ke aathon darwaze khul jate hain, jis se chahe chala jaye. Aur hadith mein hai jannat ki kunji La ilaha illallah hai. "Jannat ke darwazon ki kushadgi ka bayan" Allah hamein bhi jannat naseeb kare.

Shafa'at ki mutawwal hadith mein hai ke phir Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad (ﷺ)! Apni ummat mein se jin par hisab nahin, unhein dahni taraf ke darwaze se jannat mein le jao, lekin aur darwazon mein bhi yeh dusron ke sath shareek hain." Us zaat ki qasam jiske hath mein Muhammad (ﷺ) ki jaan hai, ke jannat ki chaukhat itni badi wus'at wali hai jitna fasla Makkah aur Hajar mein hai, ya farmaya Hajar aur Makkah mein hai. Ek riwayat mein hai Makkah aur Basra mein hai. (Bukhari o Muslim). Hazrat Utbah bin Ghazwan (R.A) ne apne khutbe mein bayan farmaya ke hum se yeh zikr kiya gaya hai ke jannat ke darwaze ki wus'at chalees saal ki raah hai. Ek aisa din bhi aane wala hai jab ke jannat mein jaane walon ki bheed-bhaad se yeh wasee darwaze khacha-khach bhare hue honge. (Muslim). Musnad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain, "Jannat ki chaukhat chalees saal ki raah ki hai." Yeh jab jannat ke paas pahunchenge, unhein farishtay salam karenge aur mubarakbad denge ke tumhare a'maal, tumhare aqwal, tumhari koshish aur tumhara badla har cheez khushi wali aur umdagi wali hai. Jaise ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kisi ghazway ke mauqay par apne munadi se farmaya tha, "Jao nida kardo ke jannat mein sirf musalman log hi jayenge," ya farmaya tha, "Sirf momin hi." Farishtay un se kahenge ke tum ab yahan se nikale na jaoge, balkay yahan tumhare liye dawam hai. Apna yeh haal dekh kar khush ho kar jannati Allah ka shukr ada karenge aur kahenge ke Alhamdulillah, jo wada hum se Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasoolon ki zabani kiya tha, use pura kiya. Yehi dua unki duniya mein thi: (RABBANA WA ATINA MA WA'ADTANA 'ALA RUSULIKA WA LA TUKHZINA YAWMAL QIYAMATI INNAKA LA TUKHLIFUL MI'AD) (Surah Al-Imran: 194). Yani, "Aye hamare Parwardigar! Hamein woh de jiska wada tu ne apne Rasoolon ki zabani hum se kiya hai aur hamein Qayamat ke din ruswa na kar, yaqeenan teri zaat wada khilafi se paak hai." Aur aayat mein hai ke is mauqay par Ahl-e-Jannat yeh bhi kahenge, "Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hamein is ki hidayat ki, agar woh hidayat na karta to hum hidayat na pa sakte. Yaqeenan Allah ke Rasool hamare paas haq laye thay." Woh yeh bhi kahenge ke Allah hi ke liye sab tareef hai jis ne hum se gham door kar diya, yaqeenan hamara Rab bakhshne wala aur qadr karne wala hai. Jis ne apne fazl o karam se yeh paak jagah hamein naseeb farmayi, jahan hamein na koi dukh dard hai na ranj o takleef. Yahan hai ke yeh kahenge is se hamein jannat ki zameen ka waris kiya. Jaise farman hai (WALAQAD KATABNA FI ZABOOR) al-kh, hum ne Zaboor mein zikr ke baad likh diya tha ke zameen ke waris mere nek banday honge. Isi tarah aaj jannati kahenge ke is jannat mein hum jahan jagah bana lein koi rok tok nahin. Yeh hai behtareen badla hamare a'maal ka. Me'raj wale waqiye mein Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke jannat ke dere khemay lulu ke hain aur uski mitti musk-e-khalis hai. Ibn-e-Sa'id se jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ne jannat ki mitti ka sawal kiya to us ne kaha, "Safed maiday jaisi musk-e-khalis."

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh sacha hai (Muslim). Muslim hi ki aur riwayat mein hai ke Ibn-e-Sa'id ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha tha. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ali (R.A) ka qaul marwi hai ke Jannat ke darwaze par pahunch kar yeh ek darakht ko dekhenge jis ki jar mein se do nahrein nikalti hongi. Ek mein woh ghusl karenge jis se is qadar paak saaf ho jayenge ke un ke jism aur chehre chamakne lagenge. Un ke baal kanghi kiye hue tel wale ho jayenge ke phir kabhi suljhane ki zaroorat hi na pade na chehre aur jism ka rang roop halka pade. Phir yeh dusri nehar par jayenge goya ke un se keh diya gaya ho is mein se paani piyenge jin se tamam ghan ki cheezon se paak ho jayenge. Jannat ke farishte unhein salam karenge mubarakbad pesh karenge aur unhein Jannat mein le jaane ke liye kahenge. Har ek ke paas us ke ghilman aayenge aur khushi khushi un par qurban honge aur kahenge aap khush ho jaiye Allah Ta'ala ne aap ke liye tarah tarah ki ne'matein muhayya kar rakhi hain. Un mein se kuch bhage daude jayenge aur jo hoorein us jannati ke liye makhsoos hain un se kahenge lo mubarak ho falan sahab aa gaye. Naam sunte hi khush ho kar woh poochengi ke kya tum ne khud unhein dekha hai? Woh kahenge haan hum apni aankhon se dekh kar aa rahe hain. Yeh maare khushi ke darwaze par aa khadi hongi. Jannati jab apne mahal mein aayega to dekhega ke gadde barabar barabar lage hue hain aur aab-khoray rakhe hue hain aur qaleen biche hue hain. Is farsh ko mulahiza farma kar ab jo deewaron ki taraf nazar karega to woh surkh-o-sabz aur zard-o-safaid aur qisam qisam ke motiyon ki bani hui hongi. Phir chhat ki taraf nigah uthayega to woh is qadar shaffaf aur musaffa hogi ke noor ki tarah chamak damak rahi hogi. Agar Allah ise barqarar na rakhe to is ki roshni aankhon ki roshni ko bujha de. Phir apni biwiyon par yani jannati hooron par mohabbat bhari nigah daalega. Phir apne takhton mein se jis par us ka jee chahe baithega. Aur kahega Allah ka shukr hai jis ne hamein is ki hidayat ki agar Allah hamein yeh raah na dikhata to hum to hargiz ise talash nahin kar sakte the. Aur hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya us ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai jab yeh apni qabron se niklenge. Un ka istiqbal kiya jayega un ke liye paron wali oontniyan layi jayengi jin par sone ke kajaway honge un ki jotiyon ke tasmay tak noor se chamak rahe honge. Yeh oontniyan ek ek qadam is qadar door rakhti hain jahan tak insaan ki nigah ja sakti hai. Yeh ek darakht ke paas pahunchengi jis ke neeche se nahrein nikalti hain. Ek ka paani yeh piyenge jis se un ke pet ki tamam fazooliyat aur mail kuchail dhul jayega dusri nehar se yeh ghusl karenge phir hamesha tak un ke badan mailay na honge un ke baal paraganda na honge aur un ke jism aur chehre baronaq rahenge. Ab yeh Jannat ke darwazon par aayenge dekhenge ke ek kunda surkh yaqoot ka hai jo sone ki takhti par aawizan hai.

Yeh isay hilayenge toh ek ajeeb sureeli aur mauseeqi sada paida hogi, isay suntay hi hoor jaan legi ke uskay khawand aa gaye. Yeh daroghay ko hukum dengi ke jao darwaza kholo, woh darwaza khol dega. Yeh andar qadam rakhtay hi us daroghay ki noorani shakal dekh kar sajday mein gir paray ga lekin woh isay rok lega aur kahay ga apna sar utha, main toh tera matahat hoon. Aur isay apnay sath le chalay ga. Jab yeh us dur-o-yaqoot ke khaimay ke paas pohanchay ga jahan uski hoor hai, woh betabana dor kar khaimay se bahar aa jaye gi aur baghal-geer ho kar kahay gi: Tum meray mehboob ho aur main tumhari chahnay wali hoon, main yahan hamesha rehnay wali hoon, marungi nahin. Main naimaton wali hoon, faqr-o-mohtaji se door hoon. Main aap se hamesha raazi khushi rahungi, kabhi naraz nahin hungi. Main hamesha aap ki khidmat mein hazir rehnay wali hoon, kabhi idhar udhar nahin hatungi. Phir yeh ghar mein jaye ga jis ki chhat farsh se ek laakh haath buland hogi. Is ki kul deewarein qisam qisam ke aur rang-barangay motiyon ki hongi. Is ghar mein sattar takht honge aur har takht par sattar sattar chholdariyan hongi aur un mein se har bistar par sattar hoorein hongi, har hoor par sattar joray honge aur un sab hullon ke neechay se un ki pindli ka gooda nazar aata hoga. Un ke ek jama' ka andaza ek poori raat ka hoga. Un ke baghon aur makanon ke neechay nehrein beh rahi hongi. Jin ka pani kabhi badboodar nahin hota, saaf shaffaf moti jaisa pani hai aur doodh ki nehrein hongi jin ka maza kabhi nahin badalta, jo doodh kisi janwar ke than se nahin nikla. Aur sharab ki nehrein hongi jo nihayat lazeez hongi jo kisi insani hathon ka banaya hua nahin. Aur khalis shehad ki nehrein hongi jo makkhiyon ke pait se hasil shuda nahin. Qisam qisam ke mewon se laday huay darakht uskay charon taraf honge jin ka phal un ki taraf jhuka hua hoga. Yeh kharay kharay phal lena chahein toh le saktay hain, agar yeh baithay baithay phal torna chahein toh shakhain itni jhuk jayengi ke yeh tor lein, agar yeh laitay laitay phal lena chahein toh shakhain itni jhuk jayengi. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aayat (وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّـلَتْ قُـطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا 14؀) (Surah Al-Insan: 14) parhi, yani un jannati darakhton ke saaye un par jhukay huay honge aur un ke meway bohat qareeb kar diye jayenge. Yeh khana khanay ki khwahish karenge toh safaid rang ya sabz rang parinday un ke paas aa kar apna par ooncha kar denge, yeh jis qisam ka uskay pehlu ka gosht chahein khayenge, phir woh zinda ka zinda jaisa tha waisa hi ho kar ur jaye ga. Farishtay un ke paas aayenge, salam karenge aur kahenge ke yeh jannatein hain jin ke tum apnay aamaal ke baais waris banaye gaye ho. Agar kisi hoor ka ek baal zameen par aa jaye toh woh apni chamak se aur apni siyahi se noor ko roshan karay aur siyahi numaya karay. Yeh hadees ghareeb hai go ke yeh mursal hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Jabke Allah Ta'ala ne Ahl-e-Jannat aur Ahl-e-Jahannam ka faisla suna diya aur unhein un ke thikane pahunchaye jaane ka haal bhi bayan kar diya. Aur is mein apne adl-o-insaf ka suboot bhi de diya, toh is aayat mein farmaya ke Qayamat ke roz us waqt tu dekhe ga ke farishte Allah ke Arsh ke charon taraf khade honge aur Allah Ta'ala ki hamd-o-tasbeeh, buzurgi aur badai bayan kar rahe honge. Sari makhlooq mein adl-o-haq ke sath faisle ho chuke honge. Is sarasar adl aur bilkul raham wale faislon par kainat ka zarra-zarra us ki sana-khwani karne lage ga aur jandar cheez se aawaz aayegi ke Alhamdulillah Rabbil Aalameen. Chunke us waqt har ek tar-o-khushk cheez Allah ki hamd bayan kare gi is liye yahan majhool ka seegha laakar fa'il ko aam kar diya gaya. Hazrat Qatada (Rahimahullah) farmate hain khalaq ki paidaish ki ibtida bhi hamd se hai, farmata hai: Alhamdu lillahillazi khalaqas-samawati wal-ard, aur makhlooq ki intiha bhi hamd se hai. Farmata hai (Wa quziya bainahum bil-haqqi wa qeelal hamdu lillahi Rabbil Aalameen) (Surah Az-Zumar: 75)
